hooks.why: Azamina Aphes bounces a card for each Fusion or Synchro Monster in your field and GY that is Fiend, Illusion or Spellcaster, so stacking those bosses supercharges its removal.

profile.plan: A WATER deck built around having the Field Spell "Umi" on the field, whose Fish, Sea Serpent and Aqua monsters gain effects, dodge removal and swing with Level 5+ WATER bosses.

hooks.label: WATER monster support
hooks.why: Every monster in the deck is WATER and A Legendary Ocean, Umi and the Kairyu-Shin cards all key off WATER monsters, so generic WATER support hits the whole deck.

hooks.label: Level 5+ WATER monsters
hooks.why: Rage of Kairyu-Shin destroys one opponent card per Level 5+ WATER monster you control and Sea Stealth Attack gives them extra destruction in battle, so big WATER monsters are the payoff.

hooks.label: WATER Normal Monsters
hooks.why: Fish Sonar searches a WATER Normal Monster and Special Summons another from Deck while Umi is up, so vanilla WATER bodies are free advantage.

hooks.label: Field Spell searchers
hooks.why: Nearly every card in the deck only works while a Umi is on the field, so outside cards that fetch or activate your Field Spell keep the engine on.

hooks.label: WATER Synchro Monsters
hooks.why: Magellanica, the Deep Sea City looks at the opponent's hand and banishes a card whenever you Special Summon a WATER Synchro Monster, so any Synchro that fits is a bonus.

hooks.label: Banishes your WATER monsters
hooks.why: Sea Stealth Attack and Forgotten Temple of the Deep banish your own WATER monsters and return them later, so outside cards with effects when banished or that do the same dodge removal.

profile.plan: Spellcaster spellcasters that pay for their Quick Effects by discarding Spells, trading hand Spells for Special Summons, removal and Fusion bosses while recycling their Spells from the GY.

hooks.label: Spellcaster support
hooks.why: Every Witchcrafter monster and Fusion is a Spellcaster, and Edel, the Fusions and Patronus all work on any Spellcaster, so generic Spellcaster support covers the whole deck.

hooks.label: Spells that work from the GY
hooks.why: Genni copies a Spell banished from the GY, Masterpiece banishes Spells from the GY to Summon, and Walpurgis sends Spells from the Deck to the GY as a discard substitute, so Spells with GY or banished effects get used for free.

hooks.label: Fusion Summons with Spellcasters
hooks.why: Confusion Confession, Celebration and Terracottan Fusion Summon using any Spellcaster monsters from hand, field, GY or banishment, and Vice-Madame, Pupils and Rilliona all just want Spellcaster materials.

hooks.label: Level 5+ Spellcaster monsters
hooks.why: Distortion requires you to control a Level 5 or higher Witchcrafter to negate, and its GY effect searches any Level 5 or higher Spellcaster, so other big Spellcasters are both ammo and bosses.

hooks.label: Recovers banished Spellcaster monsters
hooks.why: Pupils returns a banished Witchcrafter card to the GY and Patronus shuffles banished or GY Spellcasters into the Deck, so cards that reuse your banished Spellcasters extend the loop.

profile.plan: A deck of Plant monsters whose effects all fire 'if you gain LP', so it constantly heals itself to stay above the opponent's Life Points and cashes every gain in for draws, removal and boosts.

hooks.label: Gains Life Points
hooks.why: Nearly every Aromage and Aromalilith effect triggers 'if you gain LP', so any outside card that gains LP as an effect or cost is another engine starter.

hooks.label: Plant support
hooks.why: Every Aroma monster is a Plant, the Synchro and Fusion bosses use Plant materials, and Laurel turns any non-Tuner Plant into a Tuner, so generic Plant support hits the whole deck.

hooks.label: Monsters that want to be Tributed
hooks.why: Aromaseraphy Jasmine and Aromalilith Rosemary Tribute the monsters they point to as a cost, so outside monsters with an effect when they are Tributed get it for free.

hooks.label: Wants to be discarded
hooks.why: Aroma Blend and Aromalilith Rosalina discard cards as costs, so outside cards with an effect when they are discarded in your hand are free fuel.

hooks.label: Wants to be banished from the GY
hooks.why: Aroma Blend banishes Plant monsters from the GY as Fusion material when your LP are higher, so outside monsters that reward being banished from the GY can be used as material.

profile.plan: Zombie Synchro deck that banishes its own FIRE Zombies from the GY and field as fuel, triggering 'if this card is banished' effects while assembling Zombie Synchro Monsters.

hooks.label: Banishes your own Zombies
hooks.why: Samurai, Shogunsaga, Style Solemnity and Style Samsara all banish Zombie monsters from your GY or field as a cost or effect, triggering every Shiranui 'if this card is banished' effect.

hooks.label: Zombie Synchro payoff
hooks.why: Sunsaga, Skillsaga Supremacy and Spectralsword all reward Zombie Synchro Monsters specifically, reviving or recycling them.

hooks.label: Zombie Synchro monsters
hooks.why: The deck's Synchro bosses need Zombie Tuners plus Zombie non-Tuners, so any outside Zombie Synchro Monster is a compatible Extra Deck target for Spectralsword and fodder for Sunsaga and Skillsaga Supremacy.

hooks.label: Tributes your Zombies
hooks.why: Solitaire Tributes a Zombie to Special Summon a Zombie Tuner, and Swallow's Slash Tributes a Zombie as its cost, so outside cards that Tribute your Zombies are activators.

hooks.label: 0 DEF Zombie enablers
hooks.why: Style Synthesis and Samsara revive or recycle only Zombie monsters with 0 DEF, and Solitaire only summons a 0 DEF Tuner, so outside cards that search or send 0 DEF Zombies supply the right material.

hooks.label: FIRE monster support
hooks.why: Every Shiranui monster is FIRE, and Squiresaga and Skillsaga Supremacy give extra effects and protection to FIRE monsters you control.

profile.plan: Reptiles that stack Venom Counters on the opponent's monsters until Venom Swamp burns them out, with boss snakes that grow per Reptile in the Graveyard and a win condition built on counters and battle damage.

hooks.label: Mills Reptiles into the Graveyard
hooks.why: Vennominon and Vennominaga gain 500 ATK per Reptile in your Graveyard and banish one to revive themselves, so any outside card that loads Reptiles into the GY feeds them.

hooks.label: Reptile support
hooks.why: Every Main Deck Venom monster is a Reptile and the bosses count Reptiles in the Graveyard, so generic Reptile searchers, revivers and boosters work across the deck.

hooks.label: Reptile graveyard fodder
hooks.why: Vennominon and Vennominaga revive themselves by banishing another Reptile from your Graveyard, and Venom Shot sends one from the Deck as a cost, so cards that treat Reptiles in the GY as a resource chain onto those costs.

hooks.label: Extra attacks
hooks.why: Vennominaga wins the Duel outright after inflicting battle damage three times, so outside cards that grant additional attacks or direct attacks speed up her Hyper-Venom Counter condition.

hooks.label: Counter payoff
hooks.why: Venom Burn turns every Venom or Venemy Counter on a card into 700 damage and Starving Venemy Lethal Dose Dragon grows per counter, so outside cards that place counters on monsters add fuel.

profile.plan: LIGHT Dragons that Tribute themselves and each other to trigger effects, filling the field with Dragon Normal Monsters and stacking Rank 6/8 Dragon Xyz bosses.

hooks.label: Tributes your Dragons
hooks.why: Su, Nebthet, Seal of Banishment and Seal of Reflection all Tribute a Hieratic monster as a cost, and Tefnuit, Eset, Gebeb and Seal of the Heavenly Spheres all pay off when Tributed — so any outside card that Tributes your monsters sets both sides off.

hooks.label: Rewards being Tributed
hooks.why: The deck Tributes Hieratic monsters from the hand and field constantly, so an outside monster with an effect when it is Tributed gets triggered for free.

hooks.label: Dragon Normal Monsters
hooks.why: Tefnuit, Eset, Su, Nebthet and Gebeb all Special Summon Dragon Normal Monsters, so outside Normal Dragons are extra bodies the deck summons for free.

hooks.label: Normal Monster support
hooks.why: The deck's engine spits out Dragon Normal Monsters with 0 ATK and Seal of the Dragon King counts as one in the GY, so generic Normal Monster support works on the whole board.

hooks.label: Dragon support
hooks.why: Every monster in the deck is a Dragon, Atum and Seal of the Heavenly Spheres require Dragon materials, and the payoffs summon Dragons from anywhere, so generic Dragon support reaches the entire deck.

hooks.label: Mills Dragons to the GY
hooks.why: Asar and Sutekh Special Summon themselves by banishing Dragon monsters from the GY, so outside cards that send Dragons from the Deck to the GY stock both fuel and Tribute bait.

profile.plan: Dragon Link engine that revives, cheats out and moves Dragons into zones pointed at by Link Monsters, with Normal Monsters as fuel for its costs and triggers.

hooks.label: Dragon support
hooks.why: Pisty, Elpy and Agarpain lock you into Special Summoning Dragon monsters only, so generic Dragon searchers, revival and bosses slot straight in.

hooks.label: Sends Normal Monsters to the GY
hooks.why: Garmides and Promineses Special Summon themselves when a Normal Monster is sent to the GY, and Guardragon Shield sends one from the hand or Deck as a substitute cost.

hooks.label: Link Monsters as material
hooks.why: Guardragon Reincarnation and Almarduke use Link Monsters from the field or GY as Fusion material, and Pisty, Elpy and Agarpain only Summon into zones that 2 or more Link Monsters point to.

hooks.label: Small Dragons for Link material
hooks.why: Elpy and Pisty require exactly 1 Level 4 or lower Dragon monster as Link material, so the deck constantly wants small Dragons to convert into Links.

hooks.label: Dragon revival from GY
hooks.why: World Legacy Guardragon and Pisty add or Special Summon Dragons from the GY and banishment, and Andrake's best effect only fires when Special Summoned from the GY or while banished.

profile.plan: Level 1 FIRE Pyros that dodge around the field as monsters-turned-Continuous-Spells, sending their own face-up cards to the GY to Special Summon each other from the hand, Deck and GY.

hooks.label: Level 1 FIRE self-summoners
hooks.why: Snake-Eye Ash adds any Level 1 FIRE monster and Original Sinful Spoils Special Summons one straight from the hand or Deck, so an outside Level 1 FIRE that summons itself extends for free.

hooks.label: Wants to be sent to the GY
hooks.why: Ash, Oak and Birch all send 2 face-up cards you control, including themselves, to the GY as a cost, so outside monsters with an effect when they are sent to the GY get it triggered for free.

hooks.label: Triggers when added to hand
hooks.why: Snake-Eyes Poplar Special Summons itself when it is added to your hand other than by drawing, and Ash searches Level 1 FIRE monsters, so any outside Level 1 FIRE with the same trigger turns a search into a summon.
phrases: added to your hand, except by drawing it

hooks.label: Pyro support
hooks.why: Almost every Snake-Eye monster is a Pyro, so generic Pyro searchers, revivers and boosts work across the whole deck.

profile.plan: A Link-centric engine of DARK Machine relics that Tribute themselves, get effects when sent to the GY or Tributed, and pay off with Cyberse Link Monsters.

hooks.label: Tributes your DARK Machines
hooks.why: World Crown negates by Tributing itself and searches when Tributed, and World Chalice Tributes itself to send Extra Deck monsters to the GY, so outside cards that Tribute your monsters turn those triggers on.

hooks.label: Easy Tribute Summon bosses
hooks.why: World Key grants an extra Tribute Summon and World Ark counts as two Tributes, while Crown, Wand, Chalice and Ark all want to be Normal Summoned/Set, so big monsters that Tribute Summon themselves fit right in.

hooks.label: Co-linked support
hooks.why: World Legacy's Sorrow negates anything while you control a co-linked monster and Struggle destroys cards equal to your co-linked count, so cards built around co-linking complete those effects.

hooks.label: Cyberse support
hooks.why: Lib, World Gears and Avida are Cyberse, and The World Legacy and World Legacy Collapse Special Summon a Cyberse Link Monster as their payoff.

hooks.label: Revives your banished monsters
hooks.why: The deck banishes its own cards with Landmark, Collapse, Bestowal and World Wand, and World Wand's payoff is Special Summoning a banished monster back, so cards that return banished monsters to the field or hand keep the engine going.

hooks.label: Level 9 monsters
hooks.why: World Legacy Monstrosity Special Summons Level 9 monsters from the hand and Deck, so any outside Level 9 monster is free material and board presence.

profile.plan: LIGHT Spellcaster sisters that instantly turn themselves into Rank 4 Xyz bosses the moment the opponent touches either Graveyard, punishing GY-reliant decks with banishment and locks.

hooks.label: LIGHT Spellcaster support
hooks.why: Every Main Deck Exosister (Elis, Stella, Martha, Sophia, Irene) is a Level 4 LIGHT Spellcaster, so generic support for that Type/Attribute works on the whole deck.

hooks.label: Other Rank 4 Xyz monsters
hooks.why: The Rank 4 bosses like Mikailis, Kaspitell and Asophiel only need 2 generic Level 4 monsters, so the deck swarms Level 4s and can slot in any other Rank 4 Xyz just as easily.

hooks.label: Reward when used as Xyz material
hooks.why: The sisters constantly Xyz Summon from the Extra Deck using their face-up monsters as material, so outside Level 4 monsters with an effect when they become Xyz material get triggered for free.

hooks.label: Sends opponent monsters to the GY
hooks.why: Exosister Betrayal makes your opponent banish a monster whenever a monster is sent to their GY, so outside cards that destroy or mill the opponent's monsters double as banishment removal here.

hooks.label: Graveyard banishment hate
hooks.why: The whole deck is built to punish Graveyard play (Elis and Martha trigger when cards leave either GY, Mikailis and Returnia banish the GY), so outside cards that banish the opponent's GY cards share the same game plan.

profile.plan: Joke-weak Beast monsters with 0 ATK that swarm, swap ATK/DEF with Ojama Country, Fusion-summon into Ojama King/Knight, and lock the opponent's Monster Zones and field.

hooks.label: Sends your own cards to the GY
hooks.why: Ojamagic and Ojama Pink trigger when sent from the hand or field to the GY, so outside cards that send or discard your LIGHT Beast monsters activate them for free.

hooks.label: Beast support
hooks.why: Every Ojama monster is a Beast, and Ojama Emperor needs 3 Beasts as Link material, so generic Beast support works across the deck.

hooks.label: Normal Monster support
hooks.why: Ojama Green, Yellow and Black are Normal Monsters, so cards that search, revive or power up Normal Monsters reach the trio that fuels Delta Hurricane and Ojama King.

hooks.label: LIGHT Machine Fusion Monsters
hooks.why: Ojamassimilation reveals a LIGHT Machine Fusion Monster and then summons its named materials straight from the Deck, so those Fusions are the payoff.

profile.plan: Cute Level 1 Fairies stack Quick-Play Spells as Xyz materials onto Rank 2 cats, whose effects scale with how many cards are attached, then rank them up into Rank 7 bosses.

hooks.label: Discard fodder
hooks.why: Every Purrely Memory Spell discards 1 card as its cost, and Epurrely Noir discards to bounce, so outside cards with an effect when they are discarded get triggered for free.

hooks.label: Fairy support
hooks.why: Purrely and Purrelyly and all the Xyz monsters are Fairies, so generic Fairy searchers and boosters work across the whole deck.

hooks.label: Self-summoning Level 1s
hooks.why: Purrely needs a Level 1 body on the field to Xyz Summon its Rank 2 cats, so outside Level 1 monsters that Special Summon themselves are extra starters.

hooks.label: Generic Rank 2 Xyz
hooks.why: The Epurrely cats are made from any 2 Level 2 monsters, so outside Rank 2 Xyz monsters give the deck extra toolbox plays with the same materials.

hooks.label: GY Spell/Trap recycling
hooks.why: Epurrely Plump attaches any Spells/Traps from the GYs as material, so outside cards that load the GY with useful Spells or Traps give it more to grab.

profile.plan: Psychic performers that pay 600 LP over and over to search, Summon and Synchro/Fusion on the opponent's turn, with every engine piece being a Level 3 Psychic Tuner.

hooks.label: Level 3 Psychic monsters
hooks.why: Dragon Drive takes a Level 3 Psychic from the Deck to hand or GY, Amazing Dragon's bounce count and JAM FEVER!'s negation both care about Level 3 Psychics you control or have in the GY, so any outside Level 3 Psychic is another name that powers all three.

hooks.label: Wants to be sent to the GY
hooks.why: Dragon Drive can send a Level 3 Psychic straight from the Deck to the GY, so outside monsters with an effect when a card effect sends them to the GY get it for free.

hooks.label: Wants to be banished
hooks.why: Rising Scale and JAM Extreme Session both banish a card from the hand or GY as a cost, so outside cards with an effect when they are banished turn that cost into value.

hooks.label: Triggers when Tributed
hooks.why: Foxy Tune and Ogre Dance Tribute a monster you control as a Summoning cost, so outside cards that get an effect when they are Tributed work as the fodder.

hooks.label: Psychic support
hooks.why: Almost every P.U.N.K. monster, including the Fusion, Synchro and Xyz bosses, is a Psychic, so generic Psychic searchers, revival and boosters hit the whole deck.

hooks.label: Level 8 Xyz support
hooks.why: JAM FEVER! is a Rank 8 made from two Level 8 bodies or a P.U.N.K. Fusion/Synchro, and the Level 8 main deck P.U.N.K.s sit under it, so outside Rank 8 Xyz Monsters and their support are a natural extension.

profile.plan: A slow Zombie control deck built around Level 10 LIGHT Zombie Eldlich the Golden Lord, whose Eldlixir Spells and Traps Special Summon Zombies straight from the Deck and lock the deck into Zombies while paying costs by sending and banishing its own Spells and Traps.

hooks.label: Zombie support
hooks.why: Every Eldlich monster is a Zombie and the Eldlixirs lock you into Special Summoning Zombie monsters for the rest of the turn, so generic Zombie support covers the whole deck.

hooks.label: Triggers when sent to the GY
hooks.why: Golden Lord sends a Spell/Trap you control to the GY as a cost and Eldland itself triggers when sent from the Spell & Trap Zone to the GY, so Continuous Spells and Traps with effects when sent there get used for free.

hooks.label: Rewards being Tributed
hooks.why: Eldlich the Mad Golden Lord Tributes a Zombie monster to steal an opponent's monster, so outside Zombies with an effect when they are Tributed turn that cost into advantage.

hooks.label: Banishes your own GY
hooks.why: The Eldlixir cards banish themselves from the GY and El Dorado Adelantado pays you off for having a GY full of banished Spells and Traps, so outside cards that banish your own cards from the GY feed that recycle engine.

hooks.label: Big Zombie bosses
hooks.why: The Eldlixirs Special Summon any Zombie from the hand, Deck or GY, so high-Level outside Zombie monsters that are normally hard to bring out slot straight into the deck.

profile.plan: LIGHT Fairy songstresses that swarm the field and stack their bodies into Fairy Fusion Monsters, with Pendulum cards that jump into the Scales to help.

hooks.label: LIGHT Fairy support
hooks.why: Every Melodious monster is a LIGHT Fairy and Mozarta and Shopina only work with LIGHT Fairies, so generic support for that Type and Attribute covers the whole deck.

hooks.label: Fusion Summons your Fairies
hooks.why: Soprano and Fortissimo Fusion Summon using monsters you control, and Melodious Concerto can Fusion Summon any Fairy Fusion Monster, so any outside Fusion card feeds the strategy.

hooks.label: Wants to be Fusion Material
hooks.why: Tamtam and Opera trigger when they are sent to the GY as Fusion Material, so outside monsters with their own effect when used as Fusion Material get it for free.

hooks.label: LIGHT Pendulum monsters
hooks.why: Couplet locks your Pendulum Summons to LIGHT monsters, and Melodious Concerto can use Pendulum Zone monsters as Fusion Material, so outside LIGHT Pendulum monsters slot straight in.

profile.plan: Dark Fiends that Fusion Summon aggressive Frightfur toys using Edge Imp + Fluffal materials, triggering Edge Imp Chain whenever their own cards hit the GY.

hooks.label: Fusion Summon enablers
hooks.why: Patchwork searches Polymerization and the Frightfur Fusions all need Edge Imp and Fluffal materials from the hand and field, so any outside card that performs or substitutes a Fusion Summon is another way to make the deck's bosses.

hooks.label: Sends your Fiends to the GY
hooks.why: Edge Imp Chain searches a Frightfur card whenever it is sent from the hand or field to the GY, and Toy Vendor and Tomahawk already discard or send Edge Imps, so outside cards that send your DARK Fiends there trigger it for free.

hooks.label: Triggers when used as Fusion material
hooks.why: The deck Fusion Summons constantly and its materials are sent to the GY, so outside monsters with an effect when they are used as Fusion material go off on every Fusion Summon.

hooks.label: Fiend support
hooks.why: Every Edge Imp and nearly every Frightfur Fusion is a DARK Fiend, so generic Fiend searchers, revivals and boosts work across the whole deck.

profile.plan: DARK tricksters that hide face-down Defense Position, flip up for effects, and wall the opponent out while stacking materials on Xyz monsters.

hooks.label: Flip effect monsters
hooks.why: The deck's whole engine is flipping its monsters face-up - Jiangshi, Doll, Fairy and Skeleton all trigger 'When this card is flipped face-up' - so any outside monster with a FLIP effect joins that engine for free.

hooks.label: Sets monsters face-down
hooks.why: Witch, Jackfrost, Yuki-onna and Nekomusume flip the opponent's monsters face-down, and Warwolf and Fairy reward every Set card on the field, so outside cards that turn monsters face-down feed both the control plan and the payoffs.

hooks.label: Attaches Xyz Material
hooks.why: Angel of Mischief wins the Duel at 10 materials and Ghostrick Shot also stacks materials, so outside cards that attach cards to your Xyz Monsters accelerate the alternate win condition.

hooks.label: Makes you take damage
hooks.why: Ghostrick Mary only works when you take damage, discarding itself to Summon from the Deck, so outside cards that inflict damage to you turn her on at will.

hooks.label: DARK monster support
hooks.why: Ghostrick Mummy locks you to Special Summoning only DARK monsters and every Ghostrick monster is DARK, so generic DARK support covers the whole deck.

profile.plan: A deck of Tuners that substitute Tuners from the hand as Synchro Material and repeatedly Synchro Summon Tuner Synchro Monsters, cashing in 'sent to the GY as Synchro Material' triggers for removal and disruption.

hooks.label: Rewards for Synchro Material
hooks.why: Every main-deck Kewl Tune Tuner has an effect when sent to the GY as Synchro Material, so outside monsters with their own Synchro Material trigger pay off in the same Summons.

hooks.label: Self-summoning Tuners
hooks.why: Reco, Mix, Cue and the Synchro Tuners all Summon or substitute extra Tuners from the hand as material, so a Tuner that Special Summons itself is free ammunition.

hooks.label: Non-Tuner Synchro bosses
hooks.why: Kewl Tune B2B needs 1+ Synchro Monsters alongside a Tuner, so any big outside Synchro Monster is direct material for it.

hooks.label: Tuners that trigger when Tributed
hooks.why: JJ 'Kewl Tune' Tributes a Tuner as a cost, so a Tuner with an effect when it is Tributed turns that cost into advantage.

hooks.label: Tuners that trigger when banished
hooks.why: Kewl Tune RS banishes a Tuner from your GY as a cost to negate, so Tuners with effects when banished get used for free.

profile.plan: A graveyard-relic tribe that destroys its own monsters on purpose as fuel, turning every friendly destruction into searches, Summons and Fusion plays while filling the GY with different names.

hooks.label: Destroys your own monsters
hooks.why: Angwitch, Dark Blade, Mace, Tatsunootoshigo, Bone Party and Twin Dragon all destroy your own Memento monsters as cost or trigger, so outside cards that destroy your monsters are extra activators.

hooks.label: Wants to be destroyed
hooks.why: The deck destroys its own monsters several times a turn, so outside monsters with an effect when they are destroyed get it for free.

hooks.label: Mills your own Deck
hooks.why: Horned Dragon needs 3+ differently-named Memento monsters in the GY and Mementoal Tecuhtlica needs 5, so any outside card that mills monsters from your Deck feeds them.

hooks.label: Fusion Summon support
hooks.why: Shleepy Fusion Summons using monsters from hand and field, and the archetype's bosses are Fusion Monsters that recycle materials from the GY, so outside Fusion enablers fit.

hooks.label: Self-replacing EARTH bosses
hooks.why: Mementoal Tecuhtlica's ability to attack every opponent monster and Bone Back summoning it reward big bosses, and the top-end monsters are EARTH, so outside hard-hitting EARTH monsters that Tribute or Special Summon themselves slot in.

profile.plan: EARTH Insects and Plants that swarm off the opponent's Summons, Tribute themselves and their kin as costs, and mill their own Deck to pay for Synchro bosses that negate Spells and Traps.

hooks.label: EARTH Tuners
hooks.why: Beast, Barkion and Landoise all require an EARTH Tuner plus EARTH non-Tuners, so any outside EARTH Tuner is Synchro material for the whole Extra Deck.

hooks.label: Wants to be milled
hooks.why: Butterfly, Camellia and Beast constantly send the top of the Deck to the GY as a cost, so outside monsters with an effect when sent from the Deck to the GY get it for free.

hooks.label: Rewards being Tributed
hooks.why: Sunflower, Vein and Horneedle Tribute Naturia monsters as a cost, and Sacred Tree Tributes Insects and Plants for its summons, so outside monsters with an effect when Tributed get it for free.

hooks.label: Negates opponent's activations
hooks.why: Naturia Forest searches a Naturia monster every time you negate the activation of an opponent's card, so any outside negation is also a search trigger.

hooks.label: Insect and Plant support
hooks.why: The Main Deck is entirely EARTH Insects and Plants, and Sacred Tree swaps one Type for the other, so generic support for either Type works across the deck.

profile.plan: Reptilian invaders that spread A-Counters on the opponent's monsters, weakening them, stealing them and blowing them up while reviving Aliens from the Graveyard.

hooks.label: Reptile support
hooks.why: Almost every Alien monster is a Reptile and Zer'oll and M-Frame are Link Summoned with Reptile materials, so generic Reptile support covers the whole deck.

hooks.label: Sends your Reptiles to the GY
hooks.why: Alien Stealthbuster triggers when it is sent to the GY, Crop Circles and Orbital Bombardment send your Aliens as a cost, and Ammonite and Code A Ancient Ruins revive from the GY, so anything that sends your Reptiles there fuels the deck.

hooks.label: Monsters that want to be sent to the GY
hooks.why: The deck sends its own monsters to the GY by effect constantly (Recombination Device, Crop Circles, Orbital Bombardment), so outside monsters that trigger there get used for free.

hooks.label: Discards your monsters
hooks.why: Alien Shocktrooper M-Frame's Quick Effect discards 1 monster to place A-Counters, so outside monsters with an effect when discarded get triggered by it.

hooks.label: Places counters on monsters
hooks.why: Zer'oll searches any card that places counters, and Gol'gar, Overlord, Telepath and the Virus all spend A-Counters as a cost, so anything that puts more counters on the field keeps the payoffs running.

profile.plan: Turns its monsters into face-up Continuous Traps sitting in the backrow, then re-Summons them mid-Main Phase to line up big Level 8/12 Synchro Summons on either player's turn.

hooks.label: Level 8 beatsticks
hooks.why: Centur-Ion Primera is a Level 4 Tuner, so any Level 8 non-Tuner on the field becomes a Level 12 Synchro like Legatia or Auxila.

hooks.label: Summons on opponent's turn
hooks.why: Stand Up Centur-Ion! lets you Synchro Summon immediately after ANY monster is Special Summoned, so a Quick Effect self-summon on the opponent's turn turns into a surprise Synchro.

hooks.label: Monsters living as backrow
hooks.why: The whole deck stacks face-up Monster Cards in the Spell & Trap Zone, so outside cards that also place monsters there as Continuous Spells/Traps feed Auxila's protection of face-up backrow and Primera Primus's revival trigger.

hooks.label: Rewards being banished
hooks.why: Wake Up Centur-Ion! and Centur-Ion Phalanx banish your cards (Phalanx even banishes your own monster to dodge removal), so outside cards with effects when banished get triggered for free.

hooks.label: Synchro Summon triggers
hooks.why: The deck Synchro Summons constantly, including on the opponent's turn via Stand Up Centur-Ion!, so outside Synchro monsters that trigger when Synchro Summoned fire off-turn.

profile.plan: Rock Tuners that Special Summon each other, excavate the top 5 cards of the Deck and pull out Level 4 or lower Rock monsters, then Synchro Summon bosses whose Quick Effects need a monster of the right Attribute sitting in the GY.

hooks.label: Low-Level Rock monsters
hooks.why: Researcher, Analyzer, Seeker, Conductor and Raptite all Special Summon an excavated Level 4 or lower non-Tuner Rock monster, so any strong small Rock is free material.

hooks.label: Rock support
hooks.why: Every Adamancipator monster is a Rock, and Laputite boosts and Friends searches any Rock monster.

hooks.label: Stacks the Deck top
hooks.why: Laputite, Mates, the Crystals and Raptite place exact cards on top of the Deck so the excavate effects hit them, so outside cards that also arrange the top of the Deck line everything up.

hooks.label: Rewards being excavated
hooks.why: The deck excavates five or more cards at a time, so outside cards with an effect that triggers when they are excavated fire for free.

hooks.label: Fills the GY with an Attribute
hooks.why: Dragite, Raptite, Leonite and Tiamite only use their Quick Effects while a WATER, WIND, FIRE or DARK monster is in your GY, so outside cards that send a monster of one of those Attributes there switch the bosses on.

hooks.label: Non-Tuner Synchro material
hooks.why: The Tuners all Special Summon Level 4 or lower non-Tuner Rock monsters from the excavation, which is exactly what generic Synchro play needs beside them.

profile.plan: WATER Cyberse monsters that swarm zones pointed to by Link Monsters and climb a ladder of WATER Link Summons, banishing their GY cards as cost and equipping their Link Monsters to each other.

hooks.label: Link material payoffs
hooks.why: Blue Tang and Springirl trigger when sent to the GY as material for a WATER Link Summon, so any outside monster with an effect when used as Link material gets triggered for free.

hooks.label: Triggers when banished
hooks.why: Basilalima gains 600 ATK when banished and Sea Horse, Pascalus, Springirl, Coral Triangle and Snow all banish GY cards as cost, so outside monsters that reward being banished slot right in.

hooks.label: Banishes your WATER monsters
hooks.why: Great Bubble Reef draws and gains 600 ATK each time a monster is banished face-up, and Basilalima's ATK boost triggers on banish, so outside cards that banish your WATER monsters feed both payoffs.

hooks.label: Sent from hand to GY
hooks.why: Coral Triangle, Marbled Rock, Crown Tail, Crystal Heart and Great Bubble Reef all send WATER monsters from the hand to the GY as cost, so WATER monsters with an effect when sent there get used for free.

hooks.label: WATER support
hooks.why: Every Marincess card is WATER, the Link Summons demand WATER monsters, and Coral Anemone, Blue Slug and Dive lock you into Special Summoning WATER monsters only.

hooks.label: Cyberse support
hooks.why: Every Marincess monster is a Cyberse, and the WATER Link Monsters Coral Anemone and Great Bubble Reef can revive or summon outside Cyberse extenders just as well.

profile.plan: A flexible Spell/Trap engine built around Diabellstar and Illusion monsters that recycles its own cards from the GY and banishment, Tribute-summons value, and turns Level 5+ Illusion monsters into removal and negates.

hooks.label: Level 5+ Illusion monsters
hooks.why: Subdual, Morrian, Awakening and White Forest all check for a Level 5 or higher Illusion monster, so any big Illusion boss from another archetype powers the whole engine.

hooks.label: Illusion support
hooks.why: Half the deck only works while you control an Illusion monster, and White Forest and Susurrus move Illusion monsters around.

hooks.label: Fiend, Illusion or Spellcaster support
hooks.why: Sinful Spoils of the White Forest Special Summons and Fusion Summons using Fiend, Illusion or Spellcaster monsters, and Susurrus targets Illusion or Spellcaster monsters.

hooks.label: Rewards being Tributed
hooks.why: Deception of the Sinful Spoils Tributes a monster from your hand or field as its cost, so outside monsters with an effect when they are Tributed get it for free.

hooks.label: Level 1 FIRE monsters
hooks.why: Winter Raven Special Summons itself by placing a Level 1 FIRE Monster Card from your field or GY on the bottom of the Deck, so it wants a steady supply of them.

hooks.label: Triggers when sent as a monster's cost
hooks.why: White Forest and Susurrus Set themselves when sent to the GY to activate a monster effect, so outside Spells/Traps that share that trigger reuse the deck's cost payments.
phrases: sent to the GY to activate a monster effect

profile.plan: Machine monsters that summon themselves for free by discarding other Machines, then blow up your own Machines on purpose to trigger revival and search effects from the GY.

hooks.label: Discards Machine monsters
hooks.why: Fortress, Irradiator and Air Raider Summon themselves by discarding Machine monsters, and Redeployment discards as a cost, so any outside card that discards your Machines is fuel.

hooks.label: Sends Machines to the GY
hooks.why: Unclaspare sends Machina monsters from the Deck to the GY and Fortress Summons itself from the GY, so outside cards that mill your Machines load both sides of that engine.

hooks.label: Destroys your own Machines
hooks.why: Citadel revives itself, Armored Unit summons from the Deck and Defense Perimeter searches when an EARTH Machine is destroyed, so outside cards that destroy your Machines turn removal into advantage.

hooks.label: Union monsters
hooks.why: Gearframe, Peacekeeper and Bootup Device are all Unions that protect your Machines and get effects when destroyed, and Unauthorized Reactivation equips any Machine Union straight from the Deck.

hooks.label: Machine support
hooks.why: Every Machina monster is a Machine, and Unclaspare locks you into Machine Summons for the turn, so generic Machine support fits the whole deck.

hooks.label: Level 7+ Machine bosses
hooks.why: Defense Perimeter shields your lower Machines while you control a Level 7 or higher Machine, and such monsters are also ideal discard fodder for Fortress's Level-8 Summon, so any big Machine boss fits.

profile.plan: A Pendulum deck that swarms DARK Pendulum Monsters, crashes its Supreme King Gates into each other to pull Fusion, Synchro and Xyz Dragons out of the Extra Deck, and aims to bring out the 4000 ATK Supreme King Z-ARC.

hooks.label: DARK Pendulum Monsters
hooks.why: Starving Venom needs 2 DARK Pendulum Monsters, Dark Rebellion needs 2 Level 4 DARK Pendulum Monsters, and Synchro Universe needs non-Tuner DARK Pendulum Monsters, so any DARK Pendulum Monster is usable material.

hooks.label: Level 4 Pendulum Tuners
hooks.why: Synchro Universe requires a Tuner plus DARK Pendulum non-Tuners, and Lightwurm lets you Synchro Summon right after its search, so an outside Pendulum Tuner is the missing piece that stays in the Pendulum engine.

hooks.label: Fusion Summon Spells
hooks.why: Supreme King Gate Zero searches a Polymerization or Fusion Spell Card and Starving Venom is Fusion Summoned, so generic Fusion Spells slot straight into the plan.

hooks.label: Destroys your own Pendulums
hooks.why: The Supreme King Gates, Supreme Rage and Miracle of the Supreme King all destroy your own cards as setup, and every Gate plus Z-ARC replaces itself in the Pendulum Zone when destroyed, so outside cards that pop your Pendulum cards start those chains for free.

hooks.label: Recovers from face-up Extra Deck
hooks.why: Dark Rebellion and Lightwurm pull face-up Pendulum Monsters out of the Extra Deck, so outside cards that do the same keep the engine running after Pendulum Monsters get destroyed.

profile.plan: A WIND beast-and-elemental crew that Special Summons itself whenever any Quick-Play Spell is activated, and loops its own Quick-Play Spells by letting Mystical Space Typhoon destroy them so they Set themselves again.

hooks.label: Quick-Play Spells
hooks.why: Krosea, Fonix, Meghala and both Varuroons Special Summon themselves the moment any Quick-Play Spell is activated, so every outside Quick-Play is a free Summon trigger.

hooks.label: Destroys your own backrow
hooks.why: Vision, Chant, Ascendance, Manifestation and Mandate all re-Set themselves when destroyed by a Spell-destroying effect, so outside cards that blow up your own Spells/Traps recycle them for free.

hooks.label: WIND monster support
hooks.why: Krosea and Meghala lock you into Special Summoning WIND monsters only, and Mandate pumps WIND monsters, so generic WIND support covers the whole deck.

hooks.label: Recycles Quick-Play Spells
hooks.why: Mandate shuffles Quick-Play Spells out of your GY for value, and Vision's draw effect wants a Quick-Play in hand, so outside cards that recover or Set Quick-Plays keep the engine fed.

profile.plan: WIND Dragons that climb from LV3 to LV10 by sending monsters from the hand to the GY as a cost, turning each discarded body into destruction, draws and searches.

hooks.label: Wants to be sent to the GY
hooks.why: Armed Dragon LV5, LV7, LV10 and every Thunder monster send a monster from the hand to the GY as a cost, so outside monsters with an effect when they are sent to the GY get that cost for free.

hooks.label: WIND Dragons from other decks
hooks.why: Pile Armed Dragon Special Summons itself by sending a WIND Dragon from the hand, Armored Dragon summons Level 5 or lower WIND Dragons from the Deck, and Drill Armed Dragon banishes WIND or Level 7+ Dragons from the GY, so any strong WIND Dragon fits right in.

hooks.label: Dragon support
hooks.why: Every Main Deck Armed Dragon monster is a Dragon and its Spells only Summon Dragons, so generic Dragon searchers, revivers and boosters work on the whole deck.

hooks.label: Fills GY with DARK monsters
hooks.why: Dark Armed Dragon and Dark Armed Dragon Punisher need exactly 3 DARK monsters in your GY to Summon and banish DARKs as removal, so cards that send DARK monsters from the Deck to the GY set them up.

profile.plan: Small self-summoning monsters that reveal Ritual Monsters and Ritual Spells in the hand to swarm the field, then Tribute themselves with Inception to Ritual Summon big Ritual bosses while locked out of the Extra Deck.

hooks.label: Ritual Monsters
hooks.why: Talismandra and Penciplume only activate by revealing a Ritual Monster in your hand, so any outside Ritual Monster is an enabler and a payoff at once.

hooks.label: Ritual Spells
hooks.why: Candoll and Bookstone only activate by revealing a Ritual Spell in your hand, so any outside Ritual Spell starts the deck's Summoning chain.

hooks.label: Ritual Summons from anywhere
hooks.why: The deck's whole plan is putting a Ritual Monster on the field, and Thanatosis destroys a card every time one is Special Summoned, so outside cards that Ritual Summon add both the boss and the removal trigger.

hooks.label: Wants to be discarded
hooks.why: Chalislime and Crealtar both discard 1 card as a cost, so outside cards with an effect when they are discarded get triggered for free.

profile.plan: Fiend HEROes that cheat out big Fusion Monsters with 'Dark Fusion', mixing named Elemental HERO materials and generic Fiends, Warriors and high-Level monsters.

hooks.label: Elemental HERO materials
hooks.why: Lightning Golem, Inferno Wing, Wild Cyclone and Neos Lord Fusion Summon using named Elemental HERO monsters like Avian, Clayman, Sparkman and Neos as materials.

hooks.label: Other Fusion Summon effects
hooks.why: Supreme King's Castle lets you Fusion Summon the 'must be Special Summoned with Dark Fusion' monsters with effects other than Dark Fusion, so any generic Fusion card becomes live.

hooks.label: Level 5+ monsters
hooks.why: Malicious Bane takes any Level 5 or higher monster as its second material, so big outside bosses and self-summoning high-Level monsters are free bodies for it.

hooks.label: Fiend support
hooks.why: Nearly every Evil HERO monster is a Fiend, and Dark Gaia and Darkest Knight explicitly use Fiend materials, so generic Fiend searchers and boosters work across the deck.

hooks.label: Wants to be Tributed
hooks.why: Infernal Prodigy draws a card when Tributed for a HERO Tribute Summon and Malicious Edge Tribute Summons with 1 Tribute, so monsters that pay off when Tributed fit the deck's Tribute engine.

profile.plan: Cute EARTH monsters that shuffle themselves back into the Deck instead of staying in the Graveyard, reward keeping the Graveyard monster-free, and stack Rank 4 and 5 Xyz Summons on the back of that.

hooks.label: Banishes from your own GY
hooks.why: Keeping no monsters in your Graveyard powers Puddingcess's 800 boost, Petingcessoeur's self-Summon and the Madolche Nights and Tea Break negations, and Hootcake banishes a Graveyard monster as its cost, so outside cards that banish your own GY cards do double duty.

hooks.label: Wants to be banished
hooks.why: Hootcake banishes any monster in your Graveyard as a cost, so outside monsters that trigger or recur when banished get it for free.

hooks.label: Rank 4 Xyz bosses
hooks.why: Petingcessoeur, Messengelato and Mewfeuille flood the field with Level 4s for Tiaramisu and Glassouffle, so any generic Rank 4 Xyz monster is a payoff the deck can make easily.

hooks.label: Level 5 EARTH monsters
hooks.why: Puddingcess Chocolat-a-Mode takes any 2 Level 5 EARTH monsters as material, so outside Level 5 EARTH monsters are direct Xyz material beyond the archetype.

hooks.label: Shuffles your GY into the Deck
hooks.why: Madolche Ticket and Salon give a free search or Set whenever a card effect returns or shuffles your Madolche cards from field or GY to hand or Deck, and it keeps the Graveyard empty.

hooks.label: Fairy support
hooks.why: Most of the deck's bosses and Fairy-Type Madolche monsters flip Madolche Ticket's search into a Special Summon from the Deck, so cards that support Fairy monsters work across the whole deck.

profile.plan: EARTH Machine excavators that Tribute their own Machines to swarm the field, stack Levels, and climb into Rank 5-9 Xyz bosses that eat opposing cards as material.

hooks.label: Monsters that want to be Tributed
hooks.why: Dozer, Tunneller, Trencher, Crab Crane and Drag Shovel all Tribute an EARTH Machine as a cost, so outside monsters with an effect when they are Tributed get it for free.

hooks.label: Machine Link Monsters
hooks.why: River Stormer, Earth Slicer and Mountain Smasher revive themselves from the GY by Tributing a Machine Link Monster, so any Machine Link Monster is revival fuel.

hooks.label: EARTH Machine support
hooks.why: Anchor Drill Special Summons EARTH Machines from the hand and River Stormer searches any EARTH Machine, so cards that search, summon or protect EARTH Machines work across the whole deck.

hooks.label: Effects while attached as material
hooks.why: Goliath and Road Roller grant their effects to any Machine Xyz Monster that has them as material, so outside cards with an effect while attached as Xyz material stack onto the bosses.

hooks.label: Level stacking tools
hooks.why: Anchor Drill and Harvester combine Levels with another Machine to reach Rank 9, so outside cards that change your Machine's Level help hit the big Xyz Summons.

profile.plan: DARK Warrior 'HERO' monsters that sit in the Spell & Trap Zone as Continuous Traps, then Tribute a HERO to jump out, while Fusion Summoning big HERO Fusions with Polymerization and Vision Fusion.

hooks.label: Fusion Summoning enablers
hooks.why: Vyon searches Polymerization and Vision Fusion Fusion Summons using monsters from hand, field and the Spell & Trap Zone, so anything that Fusion Summons or fetches Polymerization slots straight in.

hooks.label: Inflicts damage on yourself
hooks.why: Increase, Poisoner, Minimum Ray and Multiply Guy all jump from the GY to the Spell & Trap Zone only when you take battle or effect damage, so any card that burns you turns them on.

hooks.label: Rewards being Tributed
hooks.why: Increase, Poisoner, Minimum Ray and Multiply Guy Tribute a HERO monster as a cost to Special Summon themselves from the Spell & Trap Zone, so outside cards with effects when they are Tributed get used for free.

hooks.label: Rewards being discarded
hooks.why: Faris and Vyon discard or send DARK Warrior HERO monsters to fuel their Summons, so outside monsters that trigger when a card effect discards them turn the cost into advantage.

hooks.label: Monsters as Continuous Traps
hooks.why: Vision Fusion can banish up to 2 monsters being treated as Continuous Traps in your Spell & Trap Zone as Fusion Material, so other monsters that place themselves there give it extra material.

hooks.label: Warrior support
hooks.why: Every Vision HERO monster is a DARK Warrior, so generic Warrior searchers, revivers and boosters work across the whole deck.

profile.plan: Level 4 Cyberse monsters that swarm the field and stack Levels and stats, then use their Tuners and Rank 4s to build big Synchro and Xyz bosses.

hooks.label: Cyberse support
hooks.why: Sigma, Addition and Subtraction lock you into Special Summoning Cyberse monsters from the Extra Deck, so generic Cyberse support works with the whole deck.

hooks.label: Level 4 Cyberse monsters
hooks.why: Alembertian and Laplacian want 2+ or 3 Level 4 monsters of any kind, and Diameter revives a Level 4 Cyberse straight from the GY.

hooks.label: Rewards being Tributed
hooks.why: Nabla and Division Tribute Cyberse monsters as a cost, so outside monsters with an effect when Tributed get it for free.

hooks.label: Cyberse Extra Deck bosses
hooks.why: The archetype's Extra Deck locks mean your Synchro and Xyz Summons should be Cyberse, so any outside Cyberse Synchro or Xyz monster slots in.

hooks.label: Boosts your Extra Monster Zone boss
hooks.why: Nabla and Multiplication power up a Cyberse monster in the Extra Monster Zone, and Final Sigma doubles its battle damage, so ATK doublers and double-attack enablers push those bosses for game.

profile.plan: A old-school DARK Fiend deck of masked monsters that Ritual Summons a Level 8 boss by Tributing its Normal Monster bodies, and wins with big beaters and stalling Mask burn.

hooks.label: Normal Monster support
hooks.why: Grand Tiki Elder and Melchid the Four-Face Beast, the deck's Tribute fodder and Des Gardius material, are Normal Monsters, so any card that searches, revives or boosts Normal Monsters helps the whole core.

hooks.label: DARK Fiend support
hooks.why: Every monster in the deck is a DARK Fiend, from the Level 4 masks up to The Masked Beast itself, so generic DARK and Fiend support reaches all of them.

hooks.label: Ritual helpers
hooks.why: Curse of the Masked Beast Tributes monsters from the hand or field totaling Level 8 to Ritual Summon The Masked Beast, so cards that ease Ritual Summoning or recover Ritual Monsters fit.

hooks.label: Special Summons Level 4 Fiends
hooks.why: Nuvia the Wicked destroys itself when Normal Summoned, and Des Gardius Tributes 2 monsters, so cards that Special Summon Level 4 Fiends from the hand or GY avoid the drawback and supply Tributes.

profile.plan: A Dragon engine that treats Normal Monsters as fuel: it summons them by name, Tributes them, Fuses with them, and grows stronger for every Normal Monster in the GY.

hooks.label: Normal Monsters
hooks.why: Lordly Lode and Roar Special Summon any Normal Monster by name, Beryl sends one from the Deck, and Berzelius Fuses with them, so any strong Normal Monster is a boss for this deck.

hooks.label: Mills Normal Monsters
hooks.why: Lordly Lode gives +300 ATK per differently named Normal Monster in your GY and Imperial Dragon banishes monsters sharing a Normal Monster's Type or Attribute from your GY, so filling the GY with Normal Monsters is the payoff.

hooks.label: Tribute Summon support

hooks.label: Revives Normal Monsters

hooks.label: EARTH Dragon support
hooks.why: Every Primite monster is an EARTH Dragon, including the Fusion Berzelius, so generic EARTH Dragon support covers the whole engine.

profile.plan: Machine dolls that stack Levels to swarm the field with Level 8 and Level 4 bodies, Xyz Summon Rank 8 and Rank 9 puppets, then Rank them up with Rank-Up-Magic Spells.

hooks.label: Rank-Up-Magic support
hooks.why: Fantasix Machinix searches and recycles Rank-Up-Magic Spells, Puppet Parade Sets one from the Deck, and Number C88 can only be Summoned by Ranking Up Number 88, so any Rank-Up-Magic or card that works with them fits.

hooks.label: Level 8 monsters
hooks.why: Giant Grinder, Strings and Leo are all made from 2-3 Level 8 monsters, and Gear Changer, Little Soldiers and Perform Puppet copy Levels, so any outside Level 8 monster is fresh Xyz material.

hooks.label: Detaches Xyz material
hooks.why: Cattle Scream Special Summons itself when you detach a material from any Xyz Monster, and the whole deck pays costs by detaching, so outside cards that detach give free triggers.

hooks.label: Machine support
hooks.why: Every Gimmick Puppet is a Machine, Chimera Doll requires 2 Machine monsters as Link material, and Fantasix Machinix grants an extra Normal Summon of a Machine.

hooks.label: Reacts to being sent to GY
hooks.why: Scissor Arms, Little Soldiers and Condolence Puppet send Gimmick Puppet monsters from the Deck to the GY as setup, so outside monsters with an effect when sent there get triggered for free.

hooks.label: Tributes your Xyz Monster
hooks.why: Nightmare Special Summons itself by Tributing a face-up Xyz Monster you control, so outside cards that Tribute your own Xyz Monsters are extra activators for it.

profile.plan: A swarm of Level 4 DARK monsters that stack into Rank 4 Xyz bosses, paying for their effects by detaching material, Tributing themselves and banishing the Graveyard.

hooks.label: Level 4 DARK self-summoners
hooks.why: Evilswarm Nightmare and Thanatos need 2 Level 4 DARK monsters as Xyz Material, so any outside Level 4 DARK that Special Summons itself is free material.

hooks.label: Level 4 self-summoners

hooks.label: Rewards being detached
hooks.why: Ophion, Bahamut, Nightmare and the other Xyz bosses all pay costs by detaching material, so outside cards with an effect when detached get it triggered for free.

hooks.label: Monsters that want to be banished from the GY

hooks.label: Monsters with Tribute triggers

hooks.label: Banishes your own Graveyard
hooks.why: Kerykeion and Salamandra only need any monster banished from the GY as fuel, so outside cards that banish your own GY cards feed them and synergize with the deck's banishing costs.

profile.plan: Machine hybrid Cyber dragons that equip Dragon monsters from the Graveyard to themselves as living weapons, then fuse everything into Cyberdark Dragon bosses, doubling up with Power Bond for lethal.

hooks.label: Mills Dragon monsters
hooks.why: Cyberdark Horn, Edge and Keel equip a Level 3 or lower Dragon from your GY when Normal Summoned, so any outside card that sends Dragons from the Deck to the GY stocks their weapons.

hooks.label: Small Dragon equip fodder
hooks.why: Horn, Edge, Keel, Cyberdark Dragon and Cyberdarkness Dragon all equip Dragons from the GY, so any Level 3 or lower Dragon with high ATK becomes free attack power.

hooks.label: Wants to be sent to the GY
hooks.why: Cyberdark Claw and Cannon trigger when sent to the GY while equipped, and Cannon, Chimera and Cybernetic Horizon send your cards to the GY by effect, so outside monsters with GY triggers get milled for free.

hooks.label: Equips monsters from the GY
hooks.why: Cyberdark Invasion lets you equip any Dragon or Machine from either GY, and Cyberdarkness Dragon can send Equip Cards to the GY as a cost, so outside cards that equip monsters from the GY or care about Equip Cards stack with the deck.

hooks.label: Machine and Dragon 'Cyber' monsters
hooks.why: Cybernetic Horizon searches and Chimera's Fusion lock both want Dragon or Machine 'Cyber' monsters outside the Cyberdark name, like the Cyber and Cyber End Dragon cards the bosses are made from.

profile.plan: A Warrior beatdown deck that swarms Amazoness monsters, protects them in battle, Fusion Summons its Queens and Ligers with Polymerization, and wins through repeated battles and piercing damage.

hooks.label: Warrior support
hooks.why: Almost every Amazoness monster, including the Fusion bosses Empress and Augusta, is a Warrior, so generic Warrior searchers, revives and boosts hit the whole deck.

hooks.label: Wants to be Tributed
hooks.why: Amazoness Archer Tributes 2 monsters for burn and Amazoness Scouts Tributes itself for protection, so outside monsters with an effect when Tributed get value from those costs.

hooks.label: Wants to be sent to the GY
hooks.why: Amazoness Princess sends 1 other card from your hand or field to the GY as a cost to summon from the Deck, so outside monsters with an effect when sent there trigger for free.

hooks.label: Fusion Summoning with Polymerization
hooks.why: Empress, Pet Liger, Pet Liger King and Augusta are all contact-style Fusions and Spiritualist searches Polymerization itself, so outside cards that Fusion Summon or support Polymerization slot straight in.

hooks.label: Extra attacks enablers
hooks.why: Amazoness Call lets one Amazoness attack every opposing monster and Augusta attacks twice, so outside cards that grant additional or all-monster attacks multiply the deck's battle triggers like Onslaught's banish and Sage's destruction.

hooks.label: Piercing damage
hooks.why: Amazoness Empress gives your Amazoness piercing and Swords Woman redirects your battle damage to the opponent, so outside cards that add piercing or punish opponent battle damage push the battle plan further.

profile.plan: LIGHT Machine engines that pump their Levels up to 8 to Xyz Summon Galaxy-Eyes Cipher Dragon, then steal the opponent's best monsters, Rank them Up and copy them.

hooks.label: Rank-Up-Magic spells
hooks.why: Cipher Ascension is a Rank-Up-Magic that turns the Rank 8 Cipher Dragon into the Rank 9 bosses, so any other Rank-Up-Magic that works on a generic Rank 8 Xyz ranks the deck up too.

hooks.label: Self-attaching Xyz material
hooks.why: Cipher Etranger and Cipher Bit both attach cards to your Cipher Xyz to fuel the detach-costed steal effects, so outside cards that attach themselves or others as Xyz material are extra fuel.

hooks.label: Triggers when detached
hooks.why: Cipher Dragon and Cipher Blade Dragon detach a material every turn as a cost, so outside cards with an effect when they are detached as Xyz Material get it for free.

hooks.label: Level 8 self-Summoners
hooks.why: Galaxy-Eyes Cipher Dragon needs 2 Level 8 monsters, so any outside Level 8 monster that Special Summons itself is ready-made Xyz material for it.

hooks.label: Rank 8 Xyz bosses
hooks.why: Cipher Ascension ranks up any Cipher Xyz, and Cipher Blade Dragon can be Summoned using a Rank 8 Galaxy-Eyes, so generic Rank 8 Xyz Monsters are both material and targets for the Rank-Up plan.

hooks.label: LIGHT Machine support
hooks.why: Twin Raptor, Cipher Wing and Biplane are all LIGHT Machines, so generic LIGHT or Machine support covers the whole engine.

profile.plan: A crew of differently-typed mercenaries that chain Special Summons off each other, drawing and destroying as the roster grows, then Tribute or Link them into the big bosses.

hooks.label: Changes monster Type
hooks.why: Donner, Keel and Folgo require Link Materials with different Types, and the deck's small monsters repeat Types, so a card that changes or adds a Type turns same-Type hands into legal Link Summons.

hooks.label: Triggers when discarded
hooks.why: Rafale and Wiz discard a card as a cost to negate, and Helmer discards to draw, so an outside monster that pays off when it is discarded gets used for free.

hooks.label: Triggers when Tributed
hooks.why: Donner and Rookie Fur Hire Tribute monsters as a cost to Summon more Fur Hires, so outside monsters with an effect when they are Tributed are free ammunition.

hooks.label: Punishes opponent searches
hooks.why: Rex, Ride Fur Hire draws whenever a card is added from the Deck to the opponent's hand, so outside cards that make the opponent add from their Deck keep that draw engine firing.

hooks.label: Different-name payoffs
hooks.why: Almost every effect counts Fur Hire monsters with different names, and the crew's Types are all different, so cards that copy names or spread diverse monsters keep the counters high.

profile.plan: Spams Level 4 monsters, fiddles with Levels to line up Rank 4 Xyz Summons, and stacks materials onto Utopia/Utopic Xyz bosses.

hooks.label: Rewards when detached
hooks.why: Gagaga Mancer, Ganbara Knight and Cell Phone Subtraction Girl all trigger when detached for an Xyz effect, so the deck detaches constantly and outside monsters that reward that get a free payoff.

hooks.label: Level-matching extenders
hooks.why: Gagaga Magician, Sister, Child and Utopic Tactics freely rewrite Levels to line up Xyz materials, so outside monsters that change Levels help make any pair of monsters into matching Xyz materials.

hooks.label: Utopia and Utopic Xyz bosses
hooks.why: Gagagaga Magician and Girl hand extra effects to a 'Utopic Future' Xyz Monster with them as material, and Gagaga Utopic Tactics protects and pops with LIGHT Utopia/Utopic Xyz Monsters.

hooks.label: Spellcaster support
hooks.why: Gagaga Magician, Girl, Sister, Head, Mancer and their covers are Spellcasters and Gagagashield only equips to a Spellcaster, so generic Spellcaster support covers the core.

hooks.label: Rank 4 Xyz toolbox
hooks.why: Every boss in the deck is a Rank 4 built from any two Level 4s, so outside Rank 4 Xyz Monsters with strong detach costs slot straight in.

profile.plan: Swarm the field with Level 1 Winged Beasts, stack them into Rank 1 Xyz monsters, and pile on Xyz Materials so Assembled Nightingale attacks directly many times over.

hooks.label: Level 1 Winged Beasts
hooks.why: Cobalt Sparrow and Recital Starling search any Level 1 Winged Beast monster, and every Xyz in the deck takes Level 1 monsters as material, so any outside Level 1 Winged Beast is a searchable body.

hooks.label: Attaches Xyz Material
hooks.why: Assembled Nightingale's ATK, direct attacks and multi-attack count all scale with attached materials, and Sapphire Swallow and Celestine Wagtail already feed it, so outside cards that attach more material push it over the top.

hooks.label: Rank 1 Xyz monsters
hooks.why: The deck swarms Level 1 bodies easily but only has three Rank 1 bosses of its own, so generic Rank 1 Xyz monsters with loose material requirements give it more payoff plays.

hooks.label: WIND Xyz monsters
hooks.why: Cobalt Sparrow, Sapphire Swallow and Beryl Canary grant extra effects to any WIND Xyz Monster Summoned using them as material, so outside WIND Xyz bosses get free bonuses.

hooks.label: Winged Beast support
hooks.why: Every Main Deck Lyrilusc monster is a Winged Beast, and Sapphire Swallow and Cobalt Sparrow care about the Type generally, so outside Winged Beast support works across the deck.

profile.plan: Dinosaur brawlers that pick off the opponent's monsters one at a time in locked-down battles, summoning themselves when the opponent has a bigger board and looping back from the GY as Link and Fusion material.

hooks.label: Dinosaur support
hooks.why: Every Dinowrestler monster is a Dinosaur, and Iguanodraka already discards and Tributes Dinosaurs by name, so generic Dinosaur support hits the whole deck.

hooks.label: Dinosaur Tuners
hooks.why: Giga Spinosavate requires a Dinosaur Tuner and Coelasilat is the deck's only one, so any outside Dinosaur Tuner opens the Synchro.

hooks.label: Wants to be Tributed
hooks.why: Pankratops and Iguanodraka Tribute your Dinosaurs as a cost, so outside monsters that trigger when Tributed get it for free.

hooks.label: Wants to be discarded as a Dinosaur
hooks.why: Iguanodraka summons itself by discarding 1 other Dinosaur monster, so outside Dinosaurs with a discard trigger are free value.

hooks.label: Rewards battle damage
hooks.why: Rambrachio Special Summons itself when your monster inflicts battle damage, and the deck's bosses attack with piercing and protection, so outside cards that trigger on battle damage you inflict chain off the same swings.

hooks.label: Bonus for Link materials
hooks.why: Capaptera and Terra Parkourio gain their effects when sent to the GY as Link Material, so outside cards with a Link Material trigger stack alongside them.

profile.plan: DARK Fiends that keep a Field Spell on the field so their huge Level 10 Earthbound Immortals can Tribute Summon, attack directly, and back themselves up with DARK Synchro and Fusion plays.

hooks.label: Puts Field Spells on the field
hooks.why: Every Earthbound Immortal destroys itself without a face-up Field Spell, so outside cards that search or place Field Spells keep the Immortals alive.

hooks.label: Easier Tribute Summons
hooks.why: The Level 10 Immortals are Tribute Summoned and Geoglyph even treats a Synchro Monster as 2 Tributes, so outside cards that enable Tribute Summons of big monsters fit.

hooks.label: DARK Tuners
hooks.why: Hundred Eyes Dragon and the Earthbound Servant Synchros all require a DARK Tuner, and Stone Sweeper searches Level 3 or lower Fiend Tuners.

hooks.label: Wants to be Tributed
hooks.why: Uru and Cusillu Tribute another monster as a cost, so outside monsters with an effect when they are Tributed get it for free.

hooks.label: Token generators
hooks.why: Uru, Cusillu and Earthbound Release all Tribute other monsters as costs, so Tokens give cheap Tribute fodder.

hooks.label: Other Level 10 monsters
hooks.why: Geoglyph protects itself while any Level 10 monsters are on the field, and all the Earthbound Immortals are Level 10, so outside Level 10 monsters strengthen that shield.

profile.plan: A bird deck that never Special Summons: it chains Normal Summons of little Winged Beasts into Tribute Summoned Level 10 bosses, banishing its own cards as fuel along the way.

hooks.label: Big Winged Beast bosses
hooks.why: Eglen searches any Level 7 or higher Winged Beast when Normal Summoned, so the deck happily plays outside Winged Beasts of that size.

hooks.label: Tribute Summon payoff
hooks.why: Empen and Snowl only unlock their full effects while Tribute Summoned, and Dreaming Town flips the opponent's board after a Level 7+ Tribute Summon.

hooks.label: Extra Normal Summons
hooks.why: The deck lives on chains of Normal Summons (Eglen/Robina/Stri summon another Winged Beast after resolving), and Snowl grants three Summons per turn, so extra Normal Summons keep the chain going.

hooks.label: Wants to be banished
hooks.why: The little birds banish themselves whenever they would leave the field and come back when a Winged Beast is Normal Summoned, and Empen and Snowl banish hand cards as costs, so outside cards with effects when banished get triggered for free.

hooks.label: Winged Beast Type support
hooks.why: Every monster in the deck is a Winged Beast and the searchers only fetch Winged Beasts, so generic Winged Beast support works across the whole deck.

profile.plan: A WATER Ritual deck that discards its Ritual Monsters as costs, Tributes its supporting spellcasters as Ritual material, and turns every Tribute and banish into another search or Summon.

hooks.label: Reacts to being Tributed
hooks.why: Shurit, Avance, Great Sorcerer, Exa, Ariel and Dance Princess all trigger when Tributed by a card effect, and the Ritual Spells tribute from hand or field constantly, so any outside monster that rewards being Tributed fits for free.

hooks.label: Reacts to being banished
hooks.why: Great Sorcerer and Exa trigger when banished, Nekroz Mirror and the recovery effects banish Nekroz cards from the GY as costs, so outside monsters that act when banished keep the engine going.

hooks.label: Sends Extra Deck to the GY
hooks.why: Nekroz Kaleidoscope and Divinemirror can use a monster sent from the Extra Deck as the entire Ritual Tribute, so outside Extra Deck monsters with an effect when sent to the GY are one-card Ritual Summons.

hooks.label: Ritual Monster searchers
hooks.why: The whole deck is Ritual Monsters that must be searched into hand before being Summoned, so outside cards that add a Ritual Monster or Ritual Spell from the Deck directly feed the engine.

hooks.label: WATER support
hooks.why: Nearly every Nekroz monster, including all the Rituals, is WATER, so generic WATER monster support works across the whole deck.

profile.plan: Weak monsters that Special Summon themselves into zones a Link Monster points to, then pile onto a shared Link boss whose ATK and searches scale with what it points to.

hooks.label: Extra Link Monsters
hooks.why: Every Main Deck Crusadia Special Summons itself to a zone a Link Monster points to, and Magius and Regulex trigger off monsters Summoned to linked zones, so any outside Link Monster is both a Summon enabler and a trigger.

hooks.label: Revives from the GY
hooks.why: Magius and Regulex search whenever an Effect Monster is Special Summoned to a zone they point to, so outside cards that revive monsters from your GY keep triggering them.

hooks.label: Rewards being Tributed
hooks.why: Equimax and Vanguard Tribute your monsters as a cost, so outside monsters with an effect when they are Tributed get it for free.

hooks.label: Piercing and double battle damage
hooks.why: Maximus doubles the boss's battle damage, Leonis gives piercing and Revival lets it attack every monster, so outside cards that push battle damage further close out games.

hooks.label: More attacks for the Link boss
hooks.why: Testament draws cards equal to the Link Rating when a Crusadia Link Monster destroys a monster by battle, so effects letting your monsters attack again compound the draw and the damage.

profile.plan: Floods the field with four Rank 1 Xyz Gates off one Field Spell, then doubles their ATK every time they battle until one hit is lethal.

hooks.label: Swarms Level 1 monsters
hooks.why: Each Numeron Gate needs 3 Level 1 monsters as material, and Numeron Calling summons four Gates at once, so anything that fills your field with Level 1 bodies is Summoning fuel.

hooks.label: Machine support
hooks.why: The four Numeron Gates and Number C1 are all Machine monsters, so Machine searchers and support hit the whole core Extra Deck.

hooks.label: Extra attacks
hooks.why: The Gates double the ATK of every Numeron after each battle they survive, so a second or third attack in the same Battle Phase stacks doubling on doubling.

hooks.label: Attaches more Xyz material
hooks.why: Numeron Network only spares the Gates' detach cost, while Number C1 and Numerounius still need materials for their banish and win-condition effects, so cards that attach themselves or others as material keep them loaded.

profile.plan: Stacks Zoodiac monsters onto a single Beast-Warrior Xyz, layering material-granted effects and detach-cost activations on top of a Rank 4 that grows with every attachment.

hooks.label: Beast-Warrior main-deck monsters
hooks.why: Broadbull searches any Beast-Warrior that can be Normal Summoned, and Whiptail/Thoroughblade grant their effects to any Xyz with Beast-Warrior materials.

hooks.label: Destroys your own cards
hooks.why: Zoodiac Barrage destroys a face-up card you control to Summon from Deck, and Zodiac Sign destroys a monster in your hand or field as a substitute, so any card that self-destructs or wants its own cards destroyed feeds them.

hooks.label: Rewards being destroyed
hooks.why: Ramram, Bunnyblast and Kataroost all trigger when destroyed, so outside monsters with destruction payoffs are extra ammunition for Barrage and Zodiac Sign.

hooks.label: Effects when detached
hooks.why: Every Zoodiac Xyz detaches as a cost, and Gathering lets you pay from any Xyz you control, so outside cards with an effect when detached get triggered for free.

hooks.label: Beast-Warrior Xyz bosses
hooks.why: Zoodiac material effects apply to any Xyz Monster whose original Type is Beast-Warrior, so outside Rank 4 Beast-Warrior Xyz monsters borrow the piercing, banish and negation effects.

profile.plan: Little monsters of every Element that trigger when used as Fusion or Link material, chaining Summons into big Fusion and Link bosses that Tribute themselves for value.

hooks.label: Triggers when used as material
hooks.why: Rocksies, Dropsies, Lampsies and Fansies all trigger when sent to the GY as Fusion or Link material, so any outside monster with an effect on being used as material gets that trigger for free.
phrases: sent to the GY as material

hooks.label: Generic Fusion Summoning
hooks.why: Pandemonium is the deck's only Fusion enabler and locks you to Prank-Kids Summons, so outside cards that Fusion Summon from the hand or field are extra ways to convert bodies into the Fusions.

hooks.label: Recovers banished cards
hooks.why: Rocksies banishes cards from the hand as a cost and Pranks, Plan and Meow-Meow-Mu banish themselves, so the deck steadily fills the banished zone and wants ways to reuse it.

hooks.label: Triggers when banished from hand
hooks.why: Rocksies banishes a card from your hand as a cost every time it is used as material, so outside cards with an effect when they are banished get it for free.

profile.plan: FIRE Machine and Warrior rescue crews that swarm the field, dodge and punish opposing monster effects by Tributing themselves from the hand or field as Quick Effects, then recycle their banished and graveyard cards.

hooks.label: Monsters rewarded when Tributed
hooks.why: Impulse, Air Lifter and Monitor Tribute themselves from your hand or field as a Quick Effect, so outside monsters with an effect when they are Tributed trigger for free.

hooks.label: FIRE monster support
hooks.why: Arbitrator Link Summons with 2+ FIRE monsters and Quick Attacker locks your Extra Deck to FIRE monsters, so the whole deck is built on the FIRE Attribute.

hooks.label: Effects when banished from GY
hooks.why: Preventer and Turbulence banish Rescue-ACE cards from your GY as a cost and Preventer revives banished ones, so outside cards that do something when banished get used for free.

hooks.label: Makes opponent add to hand
hooks.why: Fire Attacker draws two cards whenever a card is added to your opponent's hand other than by drawing, so any outside card that forces the opponent to search or recover gives you free draws.

profile.plan: A deck of Machine samurai that runs no Spells or Traps, attacks with its DEF while in Defense Position, and Synchro Summons huge Machines using Machine Tuners and monsters that equip themselves to each other.

hooks.label: Machine Tuners
hooks.why: Most of the Synchro Monsters require a Machine-Type Tuner, and Battleball/Fist Synchro Summon on the opponent's turn, so outside Machine Tuners are extra material.

hooks.label: Machine support
hooks.why: Every Superheavy monster is a Machine and the Synchros use Machine materials, so generic Machine searchers, boosters and revivals hit the whole deck.

hooks.label: Monsters that like being discarded
hooks.why: Steam Train King and Scarecrow discard monsters as a cost, so outside monsters with an effect when discarded get it for free.

hooks.label: Monsters that like being sent to the GY
hooks.why: Blowtorch, Helper, Gauntlet and Soulbeads all send monsters from the hand or field to the GY as a cost, triggering outside monsters with send-to-GY effects.

hooks.label: Monsters that like being Tributed
hooks.why: Coral Tributes Superheavy monsters to draw, Soulpeacemaker Tributes its equipped monster, and Thief Tributes itself, so outside monsters with an effect when Tributed get free value.

hooks.label: Level manipulation
hooks.why: Soulfire Suit sets a Level to 5, Jade raises Levels by 1 and Fist lowers them by 1 to line up Synchro Summons, so outside Level modifiers feed the same engine.

profile.plan: A Zombie Synchro ladder where each Mayakashi Synchro revives itself from the GY when the next one up is destroyed, endlessly recycling the same monsters.

hooks.label: Zombie support
hooks.why: Every Mayakashi monster is a Zombie and the revival costs banish other Zombie monsters from your GY, so generic Zombie support fuels the whole engine.

hooks.label: Revives Zombie Synchros from the GY
hooks.why: Dakki and Mayakashi Mayhem trigger when a Zombie Synchro is Special Summoned from the GY, and Yuki-Onna, the Icicle Mayakashi does this itself, so outside cards that do the same keep the ladder climbing.

hooks.label: Mills Zombies into the GY
hooks.why: Every Synchro's revival cost banishes another Zombie from your GY and Yuki-Musume fills the GY from the Deck, so outside cards that send Zombie monsters from the Deck to the GY are free ammunition.

hooks.label: Extra Tuners
hooks.why: The whole deck Synchro Summons on a ladder of Levels 3 through 11 but only has two Tuners (Dakki and Tsukahagi), so more Tuners are the main thing it lacks.

hooks.label: Self-replacing Synchro fodder
hooks.why: The Synchros climb Levels by reviving when a Synchro of a specific Level is destroyed, so outside Synchro monsters that replace themselves also feed the ladder.

hooks.label: Special Summons from the GY
hooks.why: Yuki-Onna, the Absolute Zero Mayakashi rewards any monster Special Summoned from the GY or GY effect activation with a permanent ATK-0 and effect negation, so generic GY revival is also removal.

profile.plan: Level 9 bosses that Tribute each other (or same-Type monsters) for Quick Effect removal and negation, while punishing the opponent for searching and feeding Rank 9 Xyz Summons.

hooks.label: Plant monsters
hooks.why: Mardel, Generaider Boss of Light adds any Plant monster from your Deck to your hand when Summoned, so any strong Plant is searchable by the archetype.

hooks.label: Self-summoning Level 9 monsters
hooks.why: Jormungandr and Laevatein need 2+ Level 9 monsters as Xyz material, and the archetype's own bosses rarely Summon themselves for free, so outside Level 9 monsters that Special Summon themselves fill the gap.

hooks.label: Rewards being Tributed
hooks.why: Loptr, Harr, Hela, Nidhogg, Utgarda, Dovelgus and Frodi all Tribute your monsters as a cost, so outside monsters with an effect when they are Tributed get it for free.

hooks.label: Makes the opponent search
hooks.why: Harr punishes and Boss Stage summons a boss from the Deck whenever a card is added from the opponent's Main Deck to their hand, so cards that force the opponent to search feed both triggers.

hooks.label: Token generators
hooks.why: Boss Stage makes Generaider Tokens and Generaider Boss Loot protects your bosses while you control a Token, so cards that keep a Token on the field keep that protection up.

profile.plan: LIGHT Fiend/Beast monsters that Special Summon themselves or trigger effects when discarded from the hand, turning every discard cost into advantage.

hooks.label: Discards your own cards
hooks.why: Lurrie, Cerburrel, Krus, Catsith, Ganashia, Peggulsus and Marcosia all have effects when they are discarded to the GY, so any outside card with a discard cost or effect is an activator.

hooks.label: Wants to be discarded
hooks.why: Raven, Chawa, Nozoochee, Behilmoth, Treason and Realm's Revival all discard cards as a cost, so outside monsters with an effect when they are discarded get triggered for free.

hooks.label: Fiend support
hooks.why: Most of the Main Deck Fabled monsters are Fiends, and Fabled Valkyrus specifically discards a Fiend monster as its draw cost.

hooks.label: Makes the opponent discard
hooks.why: Fabled Andwraith Special Summons monsters the opponent sends from their hand to the GY, and Fabled Dianaira forces the opponent to discard with opponent Normal Spells.

profile.plan: EARTH self-destruction engine: the deck destroys its own Scrap monsters to trigger floating searches and Special Summons, then turns the bodies into big EARTH Synchro and Link bosses.

hooks.label: Floats when destroyed
hooks.why: Raptor, Orthros, Beast, Goblin, Soldier, Worm and Kong all pay off when destroyed by a card effect, and Scrap Factory and Wyvern Summon from Deck off the same event, so outside monsters that float when destroyed keep the chain going.

hooks.label: Destroys your own cards
hooks.why: Scrap Wyvern and Factory only trigger when a Scrap monster is destroyed by a card effect, so outside cards that destroy cards you control are extra detonators for the engine.

hooks.label: Machines that want the GY
hooks.why: Scrap Recycler sends any Machine from Deck to GY and Scrap Hunter sends a Tuner, so outside Machine monsters with effects in the GY get dumped for free.

hooks.label: EARTH Machine support
hooks.why: Recycler recycles Level 4 EARTH Machines by shuffling them back to draw, and most Scrap monsters are EARTH, so support for that Type and Attribute hits the whole deck.

hooks.label: Revives DARK Machines
hooks.why: Scrap Garage Special Summons DARK Machines from the GY with their stats zeroed, so outside DARK Machine bosses like Machina Citadel become free destruction fodder or bodies.

profile.plan: Tamers and Spirit Beasts contact-Fuse by banishing themselves, then bounce the Fusion back to the Extra Deck to re-Summon the pieces, so the deck spends all turn banishing and reusing its own cards and leaning on extra Normal Summons.

hooks.label: Grants extra Normal Summons
hooks.why: Elder, Lara, Wen and the Zefra Tamers all trigger on being Normal Summoned, and Elder, Lara and Kimunfalcos each grant an extra Normal Summon, so any card giving an additional Normal Summon powers the whole Tamer line.

hooks.label: Monsters that act when banished
hooks.why: The deck constantly banishes its own cards as costs and material (Lara, Cannahawk, Apelio, the Fusions' Summoning procedure), so an outside monster with an effect when it is banished goes off for free.

hooks.label: Recovers your banished cards
hooks.why: Cannahawk's searches and the Ulti monsters' revival all pull from the banished pile, and Ritual Beast's Bond and Ulti-Reirautari want more banished material available, so cards that return or Summon banished cards keep the loop stocked.

hooks.label: Banishes as a cost
