hooks.why: Lara banishing herself from field or GY summons from the Deck and the Fusions banish their materials on Summon, so outside cards that banish cards you control or in your GY as a cost feed those triggers and stock the banished pile.

hooks.label: Psychic support
hooks.why: Nearly every Tamer and Ulti monster is a Psychic, so generic Psychic searchers, revival and boosts work across the deck.

profile.plan: LIGHT monsters that swarm the field with extra Normal Summons and Level tweaks, then stack their Levels into an army of Xyz Monsters whose detach costs power quick removal and protection.

hooks.label: LIGHT monster support
hooks.why: Every Constellar monster is LIGHT and Constellar Belt already protects LIGHT activations, so generic LIGHT support slots straight in.

hooks.label: Extra Normal Summons
hooks.why: Pollux and Leonis grant additional Normal Summons of Constellar monsters, and Sheratan, Algiedi and Zubeneschamali all trigger on Normal Summons, so more Normal Summons means more triggers.

hooks.label: Level modulation
hooks.why: Kaus, Twinkle and Cygnian push Levels up and down to hit the exact Ranks the Xyz monsters need (Rank 5 Pleiades, Rank 6 Ptolemy M7), so any outside Level changer extends that reach.

hooks.label: Xyz material economy
hooks.why: Constellar Tempest already attaches monsters from the GY as material, and every Constellar Xyz pays detach costs each turn, so outside cards that attach extra material keep them fueled.

hooks.label: Rewards being detached
hooks.why: Pleiades, Omega, Praesepe and Ptolemy M7 detach materials every turn, so outside monsters that trigger when detached get their effect for free.

hooks.label: Self-summoning Level 4-5 LIGHTs
hooks.why: Omega and Praesepe need 2 Level 4 LIGHT monsters and Pleiades needs 2 Level 5 LIGHTs, so outside LIGHT monsters of those Levels that summon themselves fill the Xyz slots fast.

profile.plan: Machine-WIND monsters that live on Tokens: every Token Special Summoned raises their Levels and protects them, and they spend Tokens as Tribute fodder for destruction, searching and Synchro/Xyz plays into Rank 7 and Machine Synchros.

hooks.label: Summons Tokens
hooks.why: Megaraptor makes a Mecha Phantom Beast Token every time ANY Token is Special Summoned to your field, and Tokens raise every monster's Level and switch on all their protection.

hooks.label: Wants to be Tributed
hooks.why: Dracossack, Auroradon, Harrliard, Aerial Recharge and the Token-payoff effects all Tribute your monsters as costs, so outside monsters with an effect when Tributed get it for free.

hooks.label: Machine support
hooks.why: Auroradon asks for 2+ Machine monsters, Warbluran and Blue Impala only Synchro into Machine-Type monsters, so generic Machine support hits the whole deck.

hooks.label: Tributes your monsters
hooks.why: Harrliard makes a Token whenever a monster you control is Tributed to activate another card's effect, so outside cards that Tribute your own monsters as a cost feed it.

hooks.label: WIND monster support
hooks.why: Every Mecha Phantom Beast monster is WIND and Warbluran locks you into WIND Special Summons, so cards that search or revive WIND monsters keep working under the lock.

profile.plan: Sea Serpents that trigger when sent to the GY as a WATER monster's cost, so the deck spends its own monsters as ammunition and cashes each one in for searches, Summons and removal.

hooks.label: WATER discard costs
hooks.why: Neptabyss, Dragoons, Heavy Infantry, Marksman and Shadow Squad all trigger when sent to the GY to activate a WATER monster's effect, so any outside WATER monster with a discard or send cost is a free launcher.

hooks.label: Sea Serpent support
hooks.why: Every Atlantean monster is a Sea Serpent, and Dragoons, Marksman, Heavy Infantry and Call of the Atlanteans only reach Sea Serpents.

hooks.label: WATER support
hooks.why: The whole deck is WATER and every trigger checks for a WATER monster's effect, so generic WATER cards work across the board.

hooks.label: Low-Level direct attackers
hooks.why: Dragoons lets all Level 3 or lower Sea Serpents you control attack directly, so any small Sea Serpent with its own attack-directly or battle-damage effect stacks with it.

hooks.label: Normal Monster support
hooks.why: Atlantean Pikeman and Phantasm Spiral Dragon are Normal Monsters, so outside cards that support Normal Monsters get double duty here.

hooks.label: Tribute fodder for Poseidra
hooks.why: Poseidra, the Atlantean Dragon summons itself by Tributing 3 Level 3 or lower WATER monsters, so outside cards that make Tokens or swarm small WATER bodies feed it.

profile.plan: A swarm of Level 4 Machines that chain-summon each other from the hand and Deck, then Link into Platinum Gadget or flood the field while reviving little monsters from the GY.

hooks.label: Machine support
hooks.why: Nearly every Gadget monster is a Machine, and Platinum Gadget requires 2 Machine monsters as Link material, so generic Machine support works on the whole deck.

hooks.label: Level 4 Machine monsters
hooks.why: Gold Gadget and Silver Gadget Special Summon any Level 4 Machine from the hand when Summoned, so any strong Level 4 Machine outside the archetype gets summoned for free.

hooks.label: Level 2 or lower monsters
hooks.why: Cyberse Gadget revives any Level 2 or lower monster from the GY when Normal Summoned, so outside monsters at that Level range become free revive targets.

hooks.label: Tuner monsters
hooks.why: Gadget Box locks its user into Synchro Summoning only, so outside Tuners let those Gadget Box Tokens actually become Synchro Monsters.

hooks.label: Searches Continuous Traps
hooks.why: Gadget Trio searches any Spell/Trap that mentions it and the deck's Stronghold is a Continuous Trap, so cards that fetch or Set Continuous Traps keep the fortress plan going.

profile.plan: WATER Plants that Tribute their own monsters as a cost for everything, and turn every Tribute into searches, Special Summons, negations and Rank 4/6 Xyz plays.

hooks.label: Effect when Tributed
hooks.why: The deck constantly Tributes its own Plants as a cost (Glamour, Sheet, Tranquility, Mudan, Hellebore), so any outside card with an effect when it is Tributed gets used for free.

hooks.label: Tributes your monsters
hooks.why: Primula, Kanzashi, Erica and Rikka Flurries all trigger when any monster is Tributed, so outside cards that Tribute your monsters as a cost or for a Tribute Summon set them off.

hooks.label: Plant support
hooks.why: Every Rikka monster is a Plant and the deck locks you into Special Summoning Plants, so generic Plant searchers, revival and boosters work on the whole deck.

hooks.label: Rank 5+ Plant Xyz boss
hooks.why: Rikka Queen Strenna Special Summons a Rank 5 or higher Plant Xyz Monster from the Extra Deck or GY when it is Tributed with material, so any such monster is a free boss off the archetype's own Tribute costs.

hooks.label: Changes monster Levels
hooks.why: Snowdrop copies one Plant's Level onto the rest, and Primula and Cyclamen raise or lower Levels, so the deck can stack exactly the Levels it needs for Rank 4 and Rank 6 Xyz Summons.

profile.plan: A deck of Normal Traps that Special Summon themselves from the GY as Level 2 Aqua monsters every time any Trap is activated, then stack into Rank 2 Xyz bosses.

hooks.label: Rewards Trap activations
hooks.why: Every Paleozoic Trap revives itself from the GY when a Trap Card is activated, so outside cards with effects that trigger on Trap activation fire constantly in this deck.

hooks.label: Sends Traps from the Deck
hooks.why: Marrella and Anomalocaris want Trap Cards in the GY to Summon from and excavate into, so outside cards that mill or send Trap Cards from your own Deck feed the engine.

hooks.label: Summons Level 2 monsters
hooks.why: Anomalocaris, Opabinia and Cambroraster are built from Level 2 monsters, so outside cards that put Level 2 monsters or Tokens on your field are extra Xyz and Link material.

hooks.label: Rank 2 Xyz monsters
hooks.why: The Paleozoics swarm as Level 2 Aqua monsters, so any generic Rank 2 Xyz monster is an easy boss on top of them, especially ones that take Trap Cards as material like Anomalocaris and Opabinia.

hooks.label: Aqua support
hooks.why: Every monster the deck makes is a WATER Aqua, so generic Aqua-Type support applies to the whole board.

profile.plan: Timid Level 2 Beasts that hide in the hand whenever the opponent Summons or attacks, triggering searches and swarms, then come back at the End Phase and stack themselves into Rank 2 Beast Xyz bosses.

hooks.label: Beast support
hooks.why: Every Melffy monster, including all of its Extra Deck bosses, is a Beast, so generic Beast search, revival and boosting works on the whole deck.

hooks.label: Bounces your own Beasts
hooks.why: Melffy of the Forest negates a monster when another face-up Melffy returns to the hand, and Melffy Pinny Synchro Summons when a Beast you control is bounced, so outside cards that return your Beasts to the hand are extra activators.

hooks.label: Level 2 Beasts
hooks.why: Melffy Puppy and Pony summon or search Level 2 or lower Beasts, and every Melffy Xyz needs Level 2 Beast materials, so outside Level 1-2 Beasts are both targets and Xyz fuel.

hooks.label: Wants to be Xyz material
hooks.why: Melffy Mommy and Godmommy attach Beast monsters from your hand or field to themselves as material, so outside cards with effects when attached get them for free.

hooks.label: Beast Xyz payoffs
hooks.why: Melffy Playhouse and Godmommy's wipe both scale off Beast Xyz Monsters and their materials, and Joyous Melffys revives Beasts from the GY when one leaves, so outside cards that reward controlling or making Beast Xyz Monsters fit.

hooks.label: Normal Monster support
hooks.why: Melffy Rabby is a Normal Monster and Melffy Rabbys rewards adding one by summoning any number of Beasts from the hand, so outside Normal Monsters and Normal Monster support slot in.

profile.plan: A Synchro-swarm deck that floods the field with Tuners and low-Level monsters, Synchro Summons repeatedly (even on the opponent's turn), and cashes in its T.G. monsters for searches and draws when they're destroyed.

hooks.label: Synchro Summoning cards
hooks.why: Hyper Librarian draws a card off every Synchro Summon and the big T.G. bosses demand multiple Synchro Materials, so any outside card that Synchro Summons is both advantage and a stepping stone.

hooks.label: Self-summoning low-Level monsters
hooks.why: T.G. Warwolf Special Summons itself from the hand whenever a Level 4 or lower monster is Special Summoned, so every outside extender that summons itself triggers it for free.

hooks.label: Level 4 or lower Tuners
hooks.why: Catapult Dragon Special Summons any Level 3 or lower Tuner from the hand and Sonic Stun pulls a Level 4 or lower Tuner straight from the Deck, so outside Tuners in that range are extra ammunition.

hooks.label: Synchro Monster revival
hooks.why: TG-SX1 and Halberd Cannon revive T.G. Synchro Monsters, but only one at a time, so outside cards that Special Summon Synchro Monsters from the GY keep the big bosses coming back.

hooks.label: Destroys your own monsters
hooks.why: Warwolf, Striker, Rhino, Cyber Magician and the Synchros all draw or search when destroyed on the field, and T.G. All Clear even destroys your own T.G. monster as a cost, so outside cards that destroy your monsters turn them into advantage.

profile.plan: A Trap-driven control deck of Spellcasters whose monsters float into searches when sent to the field's GY, Tribute each other to negate and summon, and build Link Monsters that trigger the whole deck.

hooks.label: Sends your field cards to GY
hooks.why: Meluseek, Silquitous, Hexstia, Primebanshee, Kidolga and Peritrator all get an effect when they leave the field for the GY, so anything that sends your own cards there is a free trigger.

hooks.label: Rewards being Tributed
hooks.why: Hexstia, Primebanshee and Memorygant Tribute your monsters as a cost, and Dragvirion Special Summons itself back when Tributed, so monsters with effects on being Tributed get triggered for free.

hooks.label: Link Summons on demand
hooks.why: Pookuery and Fijialert trigger when an Altergeist Link Monster is Link Summoned, so any outside card that Link Summons is another activator.

hooks.label: Spellcaster support
hooks.why: Every Altergeist monster is a Spellcaster, so generic Spellcaster searchers and support work across the whole deck.

hooks.label: Adds from Deck to hand
hooks.why: Malwisp Special Summons itself when added to the hand by an effect other than drawing, and Personal Spoofing-style searches feed it, so outside cards that search monsters set Malwisp up.

profile.plan: Spams Level 4 monsters into Rank 4 Xyzes, then feeds them extra materials from anywhere and detaches them for layered effects: banishing, draws, stealing and negation.

hooks.label: Makes Rank 4 Xyzes
hooks.why: Every Time Thief boss is a generic 2-material Rank 4, so any outside card that makes Rank 4 Xyz Monsters is a free extra boss.

hooks.label: Feeds Xyz materials
hooks.why: Redoer and Double Barrel only get their full effect with a Monster, Spell AND Trap attached, and Hack gives 300 ATK per material, so anything that attaches extra cards to an Xyz Monster is pure profit.

hooks.label: Rewards being detached
hooks.why: The deck detaches materials every turn through Redoer, Perpetua, Winder, Bezel Ship and its GY revivals, so outside cards that trigger when detached from an Xyz Monster pay off for free.

hooks.label: Generic Xyz Monster support
hooks.why: Winder, Regulator, Bezel Ship, Perpetua, Retrograde, Flyback and Startup all key off any Xyz Monster you control or materials on them, not just Time Thief ones, so generic Xyz support slots straight in.

hooks.label: Psychic support
hooks.why: The Main Deck Time Thieves are mostly Psychic DARK Level 4 monsters, so Psychic-type searchers and support reach most of the deck.

hooks.label: Level 4 self-summoning extenders
hooks.why: Every Xyz in the deck is 2 Level 4 monsters, so outside monsters that Special Summon themselves give free material on top of Adjuster and Regulator.

profile.plan: A Trap-driven control deck that pays half its LP over and over to Fusion Summon and negate, unlocking stronger effects once its LP are 2000 or less.

hooks.label: Destroys your own monster
hooks.why: Every Dinomorphia monster has a payoff when destroyed by battle or card effect, and Brute and Sonic destroy your own Dinomorphia on purpose, so outside cards that destroy your monsters turn them on too.

hooks.label: Low LP payoffs
hooks.why: The whole deck pays half its LP as a cost repeatedly, so any outside card with an effect that works only while your LP are 2000 or less is basically free value here.

hooks.label: Counter Traps
hooks.why: Reversion copies a Counter Trap's effect from your GY by banishing it, and Stealthbergia waives Trap activation costs at low LP, so any strong outside Counter Trap is extra ammunition.

hooks.label: Dinosaur support
hooks.why: Every Dinomorphia monster, including the Fusions, is a Dinosaur, so generic Dinosaur support covers the whole deck.

hooks.label: Banishes Traps from your GY
hooks.why: Therizia, Diplos, Kentregina and Reversion all banish a Trap from your GY as a cost, so outside cards that load your GY with Trap cards keep those effects fueled.

profile.plan: A swarm of low-Level EARTH Warriors and Beast-Warriors that stack the field with Tuners to Synchro into Gottoms and Hyunlei, spamming Level 3s for Xyz plays along the way.

hooks.label: Level 4 EARTH Warrior/Beast-Warrior
hooks.why: M-X-Saber Invoker Special Summons exactly that from the Deck, so any outside Level 4 EARTH Warrior or Beast-Warrior is a free body.

hooks.label: Low-Level Warriors
hooks.why: X-Saber Wayne Special Summons a Level 4 or lower Warrior from the hand when it is Synchro Summoned, so any small Warrior is live material.

hooks.label: Sends your EARTH monsters to the GY
hooks.why: XX-Saber Darksoul searches when sent from the field to the GY and Garsem searches when destroyed there, so outside cards that send or destroy your own EARTH monsters turn them into searches.

hooks.label: Rewards being Tributed
hooks.why: Gottoms, Souza and Galahad all Tribute your Sabers as a cost, so outside monsters with an effect when Tributed get it for free.

hooks.label: EARTH monster support
hooks.why: Every X-Saber monster is EARTH and Gottoms requires EARTH non-Tuner materials, so generic EARTH support fits the whole deck.

profile.plan: Wyrms that float when destroyed, Synchro Summoning during the opponent's turn as a Quick Effect and then float again when the Synchro dies, so the deck turns every destruction into a new monster.

hooks.label: Destroys your own Wyrms
hooks.why: Nine Pillars, Prana, Yazi and Brutality destroy your own cards on purpose to set off every Yang Zing floater, so outside cards that can destroy your Wyrm monsters are extra activators.

hooks.label: Wyrms that want to be sent
hooks.why: Denglong sends a Wyrm from the Deck to the GY and Jiaotu sends two cards from the hand, so outside Wyrms with an effect when sent there get triggered for free.

hooks.label: Wyrm support
hooks.why: Every Main Deck Yang Zing monster is a Wyrm and the Synchro bosses float into Wyrms from the Deck, so generic Wyrm support works across the whole deck.

hooks.label: Generic Tuners
hooks.why: Denglong, Yazi and Chaofeng take any Tuner plus non-Tuners, so outside Tuners extend the deck's Quick-Effect Synchro Summons without being Yang Zing.

hooks.label: Rewards being Synchro Material
hooks.why: The deck Synchro Summons constantly, including on the opponent's turn, so outside monsters that trigger when used as Synchro Material fire on every Summon.

hooks.label: Destroyed-by-effect floaters
hooks.why: Yang Zing Creation Special Summons from the Deck whenever any of your monsters is destroyed, so outside monsters with an effect when destroyed by card effect chain into more advantage.

profile.plan: A Ritual deck built around Light and Darkness Ritual, which Tributes monsters and banishes monsters from the GY to bring out Level 8 Ritual bosses, with discard costs and quick-response tricks layered on top.

hooks.label: Effects when banished
hooks.why: Light and Darkness Ritual banishes monsters from your GY as its Ritual cost, so outside monsters with an effect when banished get it for free.

hooks.label: Discard fodder
hooks.why: Black Chaos, Griffoh and Mind Shuffle all discard as a cost, so outside cards with an effect when they are discarded are pure advantage.

hooks.label: Level 8 Ritual Monsters
hooks.why: Griffoh can be the entire Tribute for a Level 8 Ritual Summon and Light and Darkness Ritual summons Level 8 Rituals, so any outside Level 8 Ritual Monster is a valid target for those Summons.

hooks.label: Spellcaster or Warrior Rituals
hooks.why: Black Chaos Special Summons itself by shuffling a Spellcaster or Warrior Ritual Monster from your hand or GY into the Deck, so outside cards of that kind fuel it.

hooks.label: Ritual support
hooks.why: Every boss in the deck is a Ritual Monster summoned with Light and Darkness Ritual, so generic Ritual searchers and support keep the engine running.

profile.plan: A ranger team whose Layer monsters trigger when sent to the GY and stack their Levels to Xyz Summon Mech Beasts, then merge them all into Great Magnus with multiple materials.

hooks.label: Sends your own monsters to the GY
hooks.why: Red, Blue, Green, White and Black Layer all have an effect when a card effect or cost sends them to the GY, so any outside card that sends your monsters there sets them off.

hooks.label: Changes Levels
hooks.why: Alphan and Zetan copy one monster's Level onto the team so you can stack two same-Level monsters for an Xyz Summon, so outside Level changers widen which Ranks you can make.

hooks.label: Attaches extra Xyz Material
hooks.why: The Mech Beasts cannot attack without material and only get their Quick Effects with a Layer attached, so outside cards that stack material onto your Xyz Monsters keep them online.

hooks.label: Machine support
hooks.why: All the Super Quantal Mech Beasts, Great Magnus and Blaster Magna are Machines, so generic Machine searchers and boosters work across the whole Extra Deck.

hooks.label: Activates Field Spells from the Deck
hooks.why: Super Quantal Alphan Spike only pulls Super Quantal Mech Ship Magnacarrier out of the Deck by banishing itself with an Alphan, so outside cards that activate or search Field Spells reach it more reliably.

hooks.label: Triggers when discarded
hooks.why: Magnacarrier's Xyz Summon and Green Layer's draw and Black Layer's self-Summon all discard as a cost, so outside cards with an effect when they themselves are discarded get used for free.

profile.plan: Rank 3 Xyz biker gang that treats Xyz materials as fuel: it constantly detaches materials from any monster on the field to Special Summon itself from the hand and GY, and re-attaches cards to grow its bosses.

hooks.label: Detaches Xyz materials
hooks.why: The whole deck costs 'detach 1 material from a monster on either field' (Dugg Charger, Boom Mach, Mean Merciless, Clatter Sploder), and Big Gabonga snatches a face-up monster whenever any material is detached, so outside cards that detach on their own keep the engine running.

hooks.label: Attaches cards as material
hooks.why: Troika Griare gives direct attacks while 3+ materials are attached on the field and Crazy Beast spends materials as protection, so outside cards that load more materials onto your Xyz Monsters stack the payoffs.

hooks.label: Self-summoning Level 3s
hooks.why: Big Gabonga, Troika Griare and the Rank 3 engine want lots of Level 3 bodies, and Grand Bash's level-copying can stack them into Rank 6s, so outside Level 3 monsters that Special Summon themselves are free material.

hooks.label: Banishes from your GY
hooks.why: Grand Crisis banishes your Goblins from the GY (its own removal or opponent copying it) and then mass-Special Summons 5 banished Goblins, so outside cards that banish your monsters from the GY stock that revive.

hooks.label: Revives banished monsters
hooks.why: Grand Crisis Special Summons 5 banished monsters and Mean Merciless and Clatter Sploder banish themselves when they leave the field, so outside cards that recover monsters from banishment recycle them.

profile.plan: Summons an Adventurer Token, then free-summons big monsters around it, equips them, and turns the Token's battles into draws and burn.

hooks.label: Hand-to-GY fodder
hooks.why: Curse of Aramatir sends a card from your hand to the GY as its cost, so outside cards with an effect when they are sent from the hand to the GY get it for free.

hooks.label: Wants to be banished
hooks.why: Breath of Resurrection revives any monsters from your hand or GY but banishes them when they leave the field, so outside monsters with effects that work while banished get full value.

hooks.label: Equip Spell support
hooks.why: The deck's whole payoff stack is built on Equip Cards — Thunder Discharge destroys by comparing the equipped monster's ATK and both Traps equip from hand or GY — so cards built around Equip Spells fit right in.

hooks.label: Extra attacks and piercing
hooks.why: Forest of Lost Flowers and Zaralaam the Dark Palace pay off every time your Token destroys a monster by battle, so effects that grant extra attacks or piercing turn one Token into multiple triggers.

profile.plan: Flip-effect Behemoths that repeatedly bury themselves face-down and unearth each other for advantage, all EARTH, kept alive by The Hidden City.

hooks.label: Flip Effect monsters
hooks.why: The Hidden City, Subterror Succession and Subterror Behemoth Fiendess all search, revive or Link Summon using Flip monsters specifically, so any outside FLIP monster is extra ammunition.

hooks.label: Flips your monsters face-down
hooks.why: Every Behemoth can Special Summon itself from hand when a face-up monster you control is flipped face-down, and flipping face-down re-arms their FLIP effects.

hooks.label: Flips face-down monsters face-up
hooks.why: The Hidden City, Subterror Final Battle and Subterror Behemoth Fiendess all pay off when a Set monster is flipped face-up, and each flip sets off a Behemoth's FLIP effect.

hooks.label: Effects when flipped face-up
hooks.why: The deck flips its own monsters constantly, so outside monsters that trigger when flipped face-up get that trigger on a platter.

hooks.label: EARTH monster support
hooks.why: Every Subterror monster is EARTH while their Types are all over the place, so Attribute support is what actually covers the whole deck.

profile.plan: A spread of Level 3 monsters with wildly different Types that fuse on contact with Elemental HERO Neos, recycle from the GY and banished zone, and discard as a cost.

hooks.label: Mills Level 3 monsters
hooks.why: Convert Contact sends a Neo-Spacian from hand and Deck to the GY and Cross Porter sends monsters you control, so outside cards that mill feed the archetype's GY and banished-zone recursion.

hooks.label: Uses banished Neo-Spacians
hooks.why: Contact Gate banishes two Neo-Spacians as a cost and can later revive a banished one, so outside cards that banish or recover your own monsters keep that engine running.

hooks.label: Triggers when discarded
hooks.why: Aqua Dolphin and Marine Dolphin discard 1 card as a cost every turn, so outside monsters with an effect when they are discarded get it for free.

hooks.label: HERO Fusion support
hooks.why: The archetype's real bosses are Fusion Monsters made with Elemental HERO Neos, so outside cards that Fusion Summon using HERO materials fit the whole payoff.

hooks.label: Bounces your Fusion home
hooks.why: Contact Gate has a follow-up when a Fusion Monster that lists Neos as material returns from your field to the Extra Deck, so outside cards that return your own Fusion do that on demand.

profile.plan: WATER monsters that Special Summon themselves by discarding other WATER monsters from the hand, turning every discard into advantage and finishing with Rank 7 Xyz bosses like Abyssgaios.

hooks.label: Discards your WATER monsters
hooks.why: Abyssteus, Abyssmegalo, Abyssleed and Abyssbalaen Special Summon themselves by discarding other WATER monsters, so any outside card that discards your own WATER monsters feeds them.

hooks.label: Reward for being discarded
hooks.why: The deck discards WATER monsters constantly as a cost, so outside WATER monsters with an effect when they are discarded (like Atlanteans) get their trigger for free.

hooks.label: Reward for being sent to the GY
hooks.why: Abysshilde triggers when sent to the GY and Abyssnerei and Abyssocea send your own monsters there, so outside WATER monsters with send-to-GY triggers come along.

hooks.label: Level 7 WATER monsters
hooks.why: Abyssgaios takes 2 Level 7 WATER monsters and the big Mermails are all Level 7, so outside Level 7 WATER monsters serve as Xyz material and discard fodder alike.

hooks.label: WATER support
hooks.why: Every Mermail monster is WATER and Abysspike, Abyssturge and Abysslung all reward WATER specifically, so generic WATER support works across the whole deck.

profile.plan: A Warrior deck built around Legend of Heart that revives the three Legendary Knights and fuses Dragons from specific Traps and monster Types, sending its own cards to the GY as material.

hooks.label: Spellcaster support
hooks.why: Timaeus the United Dragon summons itself and Fusion Summons by using a Spellcaster monster, and Time Magic Hammer is made from one, so Spellcaster help feeds the engine.

hooks.label: Warrior support
hooks.why: Legend of Heart Tributes a Warrior to summon the Knights, and Rocket Hermos Cannon and Goddess Bow fuse using Warrior monsters, so the deck wants Warrior monsters to spare.

hooks.label: Sends your monsters to the GY
hooks.why: The Claw of Hermos and Timaeus the United Dragon both pay by sending a monster from hand or field to the GY, so outside cards that do the same keep the engine fueled.

hooks.label: Wants to be sent to the GY
hooks.why: The Claw of Hermos sends a monster from hand or field to the GY as its cost, so an outside monster with an effect when it is sent there gets it for free.

hooks.label: Wants to be Tributed
hooks.why: Legend of Heart Tributes a Warrior monster as its cost, so a Warrior with an effect when it is Tributed pays you back.

profile.plan: DARK Fiends with zero ATK that wall attacks, burn the attacker for its full ATK, and evolve up a chain when destroyed, paying their upkeep by Tributing another monster each turn.

hooks.label: Tribute fodder Tokens
hooks.why: Yubel must Tribute 1 other monster during every End Phase or destroy itself, so cheap bodies and Token generators keep it alive.

hooks.label: Destroys your own monsters
hooks.why: Yubel Special Summons Terror Incarnate from hand, Deck or GY when it is destroyed by anything except its own effect, so self-destruction effects start the evolution chain on purpose.

hooks.label: Forces opponent attacks
hooks.why: Yubel, Terror Incarnate and Ultimate Nightmare burn the attacker for its full ATK before damage calculation, so cards that make the opponent's monsters attack turn the wall into a win condition.

hooks.label: Fusion Summons with field materials
hooks.why: The Loving Defender Forever fuses a Yubel monster with any Effect Monsters on the field, so generic Fusion cards that use field monsters summon it without dedicated materials.

hooks.label: Dark Fiend support
hooks.why: Every Yubel monster is a DARK Fiend, so Type and Attribute support covers the whole chain and its Fusion boss.

profile.plan: A Spellcaster circus that Special Summons from the hand and hand-triggers off destruction and effect damage, culminating in Rank 4/5 Xyz bosses; it happily damages itself, so effect damage becomes fuel rather than a cost.

hooks.label: Spellcaster support
hooks.why: Every Performage monster is a Spellcaster and Trapeze Magician needs 2 Level 4 Spellcasters as Xyz material, so generic Spellcaster search and revival works on the whole deck.

hooks.label: Level 4-5 Spellcaster bodies
hooks.why: Trapeze Magician asks for 2 Level 4 Spellcasters and Trapeze High Magician for 2 Level 5 Spellcasters, so outside monsters of exactly that shape are Xyz material.

hooks.label: Damages yourself
hooks.why: Trapeze High Magician makes your opponent take effect damage you would have taken, and Hat Tricker and Flame Eater react to any effect that would damage you, so self-burn cards become advantage.

hooks.label: Effect damage dealers
hooks.why: Stilts Launcher punishes any effect that would inflict damage to your opponent with 2000 burn of its own, so outside burn effects stack on top.

hooks.label: Destroys your own monsters
hooks.why: Plushfire, Trapeze Magician and Trick Box all pay off when your Performage monsters are destroyed by card effect, and Ball Balancer destroys them itself, so removal aimed at your side of the field is a combo piece.

hooks.label: Rank-Up-Magic Spells
hooks.why: Shadow Maker sends a Performage from Deck to GY to search a Rank-Up-Magic Spell, and its Rank 5 body is made to be ranked up.

profile.plan: A Link-climbing deck built on Normal Monsters: it Normal Summons its Normal Monsters, uses them as Link material, and every World Chalice Link monster floats by Summoning another from the hand or Deck when sent from the field to the GY.

hooks.label: Normal Monsters
hooks.why: Imduk Link Summons using '1 Normal Monster' as material, Guardragon revives a Normal Monster from the GY, and Ib can treat a World Chalice Normal Monster as a Tuner, so any outside Normal Monster is usable material.

hooks.label: Normal Monster support
hooks.why: The deck's Main Deck core is three Normal Monsters, so outside cards that search or Summon Normal Monsters from the Deck or GY feed every Link in the deck.

hooks.label: Sends your field to the GY
hooks.why: Ningirsu sends 1 card from each player's field to the GY every turn, which triggers every World Chalice Link's 'sent from the field to the GY' effect.

hooks.label: Floats when sent from the field
hooks.why: Lee sends a monster from the hand or field to the GY as a cost and Ningirsu sends your field to the GY, so outside monsters with an effect when they leave the field to the GY get it for free.

hooks.label: Tribute-trigger monsters
hooks.why: Auram Tributes a World Chalice monster it points to as a cost for its revive effect, so outside monsters that trigger when Tributed turn that cost into value.

profile.plan: Level 10 Fairies that Normal Summon themselves for free when you control no monsters, punch the opponent, trigger an end-of-Battle-Phase effect, then shuffle back into the Deck every turn.

hooks.label: Level 10 GY fodder
hooks.why: Empty Machine's draw effect discards a Level 10 monster, and the whole deck is Level 10, so outside Level 10 monsters with effects in the GY get discarded for free.

hooks.label: Fairy support
hooks.why: Every Timelord, including Sephylon and Vorpgate, is a Fairy, so generic Fairy searchers and revival work on the whole deck.

hooks.label: Big Fairies for Sephylon
hooks.why: Sephylon Special Summons a Level 8 or higher Fairy from the hand or GY and makes it a 4000 ATK beatstick, so any large Fairy is usable material.

hooks.label: Fills your Graveyard
hooks.why: Sephylon, the Ultimate Timelord needs 10 or more monsters in your GY, so outside cards that send monsters there build toward it.

hooks.label: Tuners for Vorpgate
hooks.why: Timelord Progenitor Vorpgate is a Level 10 Synchro needing a Tuner plus non-Tuners, and Sephylon can revive the Level 10 Timelords as non-Tuners to feed it.

hooks.label: Forces battles
hooks.why: The Timelords' payoffs only fire at the end of the Battle Phase if they battled, and they take no battle damage and cannot be destroyed by battle, so outside cards that force attacks are pure upside.

profile.plan: A WIND Synchro engine built around Clear Wing Synchro Dragons that negate monster effects, feed off each other's Levels and Tuners, and double as Speedroid cards.

hooks.label: Speedroid cards
hooks.why: Clear Wing Fast Dragon's Pendulum Summon needs a 'Speedroid' Tuner, and this deck's Clear Wing cards are all treated as Speedroid cards, so the Speedroid engine slots straight in.

hooks.label: WIND Synchro support
hooks.why: Speedroid Clear Wing Wonder destroys cards based on the WIND Synchro Monsters you control, and Four Heavenly Dragons Synchro Summons WIND Synchro Monsters, so cards built around WIND Synchro Monsters multiply the deck's payoff.

hooks.label: Tuner Synchro Monsters
hooks.why: Crystal Clear Wing and Crystal Clear Wing Over Synchro Dragon require a 'Tuner Synchro Monster' as material, so outside Synchro Monsters that are themselves Tuners are premium Synchro material.

hooks.label: WIND monster support
hooks.why: The deck Synchro Summons with WIND materials and Crystal Clear Wing adds a WIND monster from the Deck when it dies, so cards that search, revive or boost WIND monsters work throughout.

hooks.label: Banish-and-return tricks
hooks.why: Speedroid Clear Wing Wonder banishes a WIND Synchro Monster and returns it to the field, so monsters with effects that trigger when they leave the field or return get used for free.

profile.plan: Machine monsters led by Jinzo that shut off Trap Cards, punish opponents for playing them, and stack Level 6 bodies for Rank 6 Xyz Summons.

hooks.label: Machine support
hooks.why: Every Jinzo and Jinzo ally is a Machine, so cards that search, revive or protect Machines work across the whole deck.

hooks.label: Level 6 monsters
hooks.why: Jinzo - Layered needs 2 Level 6 monsters as material and the core Jinzos are all Level 6, so any outside Level 6 monster is both an Xyz body and Tribute Summon material.

hooks.label: Monsters that want to be Tributed
hooks.why: Jinzo - Jector, Jinzo the Machine Menace and Jinzo - Layered all Tribute monsters as a cost, so outside monsters with effects when they are Tributed get those effects for free.

hooks.label: Monsters that want to be sent to the GY
hooks.why: Psychic Wave sends Jinzo monsters from the hand or Deck to the GY as a cost, so outside monsters with effects when sent to the GY trigger for free.

hooks.label: Easy Tribute Summon bosses
hooks.why: The deck is built around Tribute Summoning Level 6+ Machines like Jinzo, so outside monsters that Tribute Summon themselves with one Tribute or less slot straight in.

profile.plan: A Zombie deck built around the classic Continuous Trap Call of the Haunted: it Sets and reuses the Trap from the Deck and GY to revive Level 6 Zombies over and over, then stacks them into a Rank 6 boss.

hooks.label: Level 6 Zombie monsters
hooks.why: Pumpking the King of Grave Ghosts Special Summons Level 6 Zombies straight from the Deck, and two of them make the Rank 6 Pumpking the Great Ghost King, so any outside Level 6 Zombie is material or a body.

hooks.label: Revives from the GY
hooks.why: The deck's whole engine is reviving Zombies with Call of the Haunted and re-Summoning Army of the Haunted from the GY, so more revival keeps the board full.

hooks.label: Wants to be destroyed
hooks.why: Call of the Haunted destroys its revived monster the moment it leaves the field, so an outside monster with an effect when it is destroyed or sent to the GY turns that drawback into value.

hooks.label: Triggers off being discarded
hooks.why: Pumpking the King of Grave Ghosts reveals itself and then discards 1 card as a cost, so outside cards with an effect when they are discarded get used for free.

hooks.label: Zombie support
hooks.why: Every monster in the deck is a Zombie and Call of the Forgotten locks you into Zombie Summons, so generic Zombie support fits the whole deck.

profile.plan: Spellcasters that pile into the center Main Monster Zone and Synchro Summon around it, spending their own monsters from hand and field to keep the engine going.

hooks.label: Synchro Summon support
hooks.why: Elfnote Power Patron, Strelitzia and Welcome Home all lock the Extra Deck to Synchro Monsters, so the whole deck is built around Synchro Summoning.

hooks.label: Spellcaster support
hooks.why: Lucina, Tinia, Regina and Fortuna are all Spellcasters and Elfnote June Pride needs a non-Tuner Spellcaster as material, so generic Spellcaster help covers the whole Main Deck.

hooks.label: Wants to be sent to the GY
hooks.why: Welcome Home and Rhapsodia of Madness send monsters from your hand or field to the GY as a cost, so outside monsters with effects in the GY get used for free.

hooks.label: Wants to be banished face-down
hooks.why: Junoldo the Shadespirit Power Patron banishes the top 3 cards of your Deck face-down as a cost, so outside cards with an effect when banished face-down turn that cost into value.

profile.plan: Level 1 DARK Zombies that grow stronger the more of their kind sit in the Graveyard, deliberately dumping and banishing themselves to fatten the King of the Skull Servants.

hooks.label: Mills Zombies into the GY
hooks.why: The deck's whole payoff is Skull Servants piling up in the GY for the King's ATK and Wightprince's Summon, so anything that sends Zombies from the Deck to the GY feeds it.

hooks.label: Wants to be sent to the GY
hooks.why: Wightprincess sends cards from the hand or field to the GY and Wightprince mills itself, so outside monsters with an effect when they hit the GY get it for free.

hooks.label: Discards your own Zombies
hooks.why: Wightmare activates from the hand by being discarded, and every Skull Servant wants to be in the GY anyway, so discard outlets double as setup.

hooks.label: Zombie support
hooks.why: Every Skull Servant monster is a Zombie, and Wightprincess and Wightprince both need more Zombie bodies moving between zones, so generic Zombie revival and search all fits.

hooks.label: Low-Level Zombies
hooks.why: The Lady in Wight protects all face-up Level 3 or lower Zombies from battle and Spell/Trap effects, so any small Zombie from outside the archetype becomes a protected body.

profile.plan: Aggressive monsters that destroy themselves each End Phase unless you pay upkeep with the Iron Core or by revealing matching-Type monsters in hand, in exchange for built-in negation and LIGHT/DARK punishment.

hooks.label: Rock monsters in hand
hooks.why: Most of the deck's negators (Guardian, Overload, Sandman, Wall, Supplier) stay alive by revealing a Rock monster in your hand each End Phase, so any outside Rock doubles as upkeep fuel.

hooks.label: Sends your Rocks to the GY
hooks.why: Koa'ki Meiru Supplier Special Summons itself from hand whenever a face-up Rock you control is sent to the GY, so outside cards that send your own Rock field monsters there trigger it for free.

hooks.label: Rewards being Tributed
hooks.why: Guardian, Overload, Sandman and Wall Tribute themselves as a cost and Koa'ki Meiru Initialize! Tributes your Koa'ki Meiru, so outside monsters with an effect when Tributed get value from those costs.

hooks.label: Easy Tribute Summon bosses
hooks.why: Rooklord and Valafar are big bosses you Tribute Summon by Tributing just one Koa'ki Meiru monster, so outside monsters with their own easy Tribute Summon stack with the deck's Tribute engine.

hooks.label: Rock support
hooks.why: Over half the archetype is Rock, including all its self-Tributing negators, so generic Rock search, revival and boosts cover the core of the deck.

profile.plan: LIGHT Fairy Ritual Monsters searched and Ritual Summoned with Machine Angel Ritual, which Tributes Fairies from hand and field or recycles them from the GY; Benten and Idaten pay off when they are Tributed.

hooks.label: Tributes your Fairies
hooks.why: Benten searches a LIGHT Fairy and Idaten boosts your Rituals when Tributed, and the Ritual Spells Tribute monsters from the hand or field, so any outside card that Tributes your monsters doubles as Ritual fuel and a trigger.

hooks.label: Reacts to being Tributed
hooks.why: Benten and Idaten have effects when they are Tributed, so outside monsters with their own 'if this card is Tributed' trigger get their effect for free when used as Ritual material.

hooks.label: Ritual support
hooks.why: The whole deck is Ritual Monsters relying on Ritual Spells, so generic Ritual searchers, ritual_summon enablers and recovery all slot straight in.

hooks.label: Shuffles your GY back
hooks.why: Machine Angel Absolute Ritual uses Fairy or Warrior monsters shuffled from your GY as material, and Vrash and Izana shuffle Ritual Monsters from the GY back into the Deck as costs, so outside cards that return your cards from the GY to the Deck keep both supplied.

hooks.label: LIGHT Fairy monsters
hooks.why: Benten searches any LIGHT Fairy when Tributed and Magnificent Machine Angel buffs a LIGHT Fairy, so strong outside LIGHT Fairies are the best Tribute fodder and targets.

hooks.label: Ritual Monster payoffs
hooks.why: Dakini, Vrash, Natasha and Izana all get extra effects while you control any Ritual Monster or when one attacks, so outside Ritual Monsters stack with them.

profile.plan: FIRE Dragons that Synchro Summon during the Battle Phase and hammer the opponent with repeated, protected attacks while taking no battle damage themselves.

hooks.label: FIRE Dragon support
hooks.why: Every Tenpai Dragon is a FIRE Dragon, and Chundra, Fadra and Paidra all check for FIRE Dragon monsters, so generic FIRE Dragon support works across the whole deck.

hooks.label: Low-level FIRE Dragons
hooks.why: Chundra Special Summons any Level 4 or lower FIRE Dragon from the Deck and Fadra revives them from the GY, so small outside FIRE Dragons get summoned for free.

hooks.label: Battle Phase Quick Effects
hooks.why: The whole deck acts during the Battle Phase (Synchro Summoning mid-battle), so outside cards with Quick Effects usable then line up perfectly.

hooks.label: Extra attacks and piercing
hooks.why: Paidra stops your battle damage and Fadra stops your FIRE Dragons being destroyed by battle, so attacking repeatedly or with piercing is pure profit.

hooks.label: Triggers when added to hand
hooks.why: Genroku Special Summons itself when added to your hand by any means other than drawing, so outside cards that add monsters from the Deck to the hand set it off.

hooks.label: Rewards being Synchro material
hooks.why: The dragons Synchro Summon using themselves as material during the Battle Phase, so outside monsters with an effect when used as Synchro material get it for free.

profile.plan: A Synchro toolbox built around Baronne de Fleur, with Sauge blowing up cards (including your own) to summon itself and Fleuret reviving tiny monsters and latching onto Synchro bosses.

hooks.label: Level 1 Plant monsters
hooks.why: Sauge de Fleur's Graveyard effect searches a Level 1 Plant straight from the Deck or GY, so any outside Level 1 Plant with a useful effect is a payoff.

hooks.label: Synchro boss monsters
hooks.why: Baronne de Fleur is a Level 10 Synchro and Fleuret re-equips itself to a Synchro Monster you control, so big outside Synchroes fit the deck's payoffs.

hooks.label: Floats when destroyed
hooks.why: Sauge de Fleur destroys 1 monster you control as part of its Summon, so outside monsters with an effect when they are destroyed get it for free.

hooks.label: Tuner and Level spam
hooks.why: Baronne needs 1 Tuner plus non-Tuners totaling Level 10, so outside cards that spam low-Level monsters or extra Summons make her easier to build.

profile.plan: Quick-Play 'Mask Change' Spells swap any HERO you control for a same-Attribute Masked HERO from the Extra Deck, turning cheap HEROes into bigger Fusion bodies mid-combat.

hooks.label: Discard-payoff cards
hooks.why: Mask Change II's activation cost is discarding 1 card, so outside cards with an effect when they are discarded get used for free every time you transform.

hooks.label: Monsters that want to be sent
hooks.why: Mask Change II sends a face-up monster you control to the GY to Summon the Masked HERO, so outside monsters with an effect when they are sent there by a card effect profit from being used as material — Masked HERO Fountain works exactly this way.

hooks.label: Other HERO monsters
hooks.why: Mask Change II and Form Change only need any face-up 'HERO' monster as the swap material, and Dian Special Summons any Level 4 or lower 'HERO' from the Deck, so HERO monsters from outside the archetype are the fuel and the payoffs.

hooks.label: Warrior support
hooks.why: Every Masked HERO is a Warrior, so generic Warrior searchers, revival and boosts work across the whole archetype including the Fusion bosses.

hooks.label: Battle-reward monsters
hooks.why: Anki, Divine Wind and Dian all pay off when they destroy a monster by battle, so outside cards that make your monsters destroy by battle more often — piercing, extra attacks or ATK boosts — chain into their searches and draws.

profile.plan: A Plant Synchro deck built around Black Rose Dragon: it swarms Tuners, revives and recycles Rose Dragons, and stacks Level 7+ Plants for big Tribute Summons while wiping the field.

hooks.label: Sends your Plants to the GY
hooks.why: Rose Girl Special Summons itself from the hand when a face-up Plant you control is sent to the GY, and Rage Rose Witch mills Plants on Summon, so any outside card that dumps your Plants fuels both.

hooks.label: Plant Synchro Monsters
hooks.why: Ruddy Rose Dragon gets its full field wipe when Synchro Summoned using a Plant Synchro Monster as material, and Bramble Rose Dragon needs a Plant Tuner, so other Plant Synchro bosses slot straight in as material and payoff.

hooks.label: Big Tribute Summon monsters
hooks.why: Rose Papillon grants an extra Tribute Summon of a Level 7+ monster, so outside bosses that are cheap to Tribute Summon become free extra bodies.

hooks.label: Plant Type support
hooks.why: Nearly every Rose monster is a Plant and Black Rose Garden turns all face-up monsters into Plants, so generic Plant searchers, boosters and revival work on the whole board.

hooks.label: Revives Tuners from the GY
hooks.why: The deck Synchro Summons constantly and Bramble Rose Dragon can Special Summon a Level 4 or lower Plant Tuner from the GY, so outside cards that bring Tuners back keep the Synchro engine going.

profile.plan: Beast-Warrior brawlers that stack face-up 'Fire Formation' Continuous Spells/Traps, pay them off by sending them to the GY as costs, and loop monsters and formations out of the Deck.

hooks.label: Beast-Warrior support
hooks.why: Every Fire Fist monster is a Beast-Warrior, Tiger King and Eagle use generic Beast-Warrior materials, and Spirit only Synchro Summons Beast-Warriors, so anything that searches, revives or boosts Beast-Warriors works across the deck.

hooks.label: FIRE Tuners
hooks.why: Horse Prince and Kirin each require a FIRE Tuner, and the archetype only has two of its own.

hooks.label: Level 3 FIRE monsters
hooks.why: Spirit revives a Level 3 FIRE monster with 200 or less DEF and Horse Prince Special Summons a Level 3 FIRE monster straight from the Deck, so any outside one is free material.

hooks.label: Level 4 Beast-Warriors
hooks.why: Tiger King takes 2 Level 4 Beast-Warriors as Xyz material and summons more Level 4 or lower Beast-Warriors from the Deck, so outside Level 4 Beast-Warriors slot straight in.

hooks.label: Continuous Spells and Traps
hooks.why: The whole engine runs on face-up Continuous 'Fire Formation' cards, and Kirin scales with every face-up Spell/Trap you control, so outside cards that reward or protect Continuous Spells/Traps compound it.

hooks.label: Sends your face-up Spells/Traps
hooks.why: Bear, Gorilla, Dragon and Swan all pay by sending face-up 'Fire Formation' cards to the GY, so outside cards that send your own face-up Spells/Traps to the GY feed that same economy and trigger Snake.

profile.plan: DARK Dragons and WIND Machines that destroy their own cards on purpose, strap on Equip Spells, and stack everything into Rank 4-8 WIND Machine Xyz bosses that equip enemy monsters.

hooks.label: Destroys your own cards
hooks.why: Amalthe, Elara, Raiders, Diactorus and Jupredo all pay by destroying your DoomZ cards in the hand or on the field, so any outside card that destroys your own stuff is another activator.

hooks.label: Triggers when destroyed
hooks.why: Nearly every DoomZ monster and Spell/Trap has a payoff when destroyed by a card effect, and the deck destroys them itself, so outside cards that want to be destroyed get it for free.

hooks.label: WIND Machine Xyz bosses
hooks.why: Amalthe, Elara and Drastea Xyz Summon any WIND Machine Xyz Monster from the Extra Deck with the same Rank as their Level, so outside WIND Machine Xyz monsters at Rank 4 and Rank 8 are free bosses.

hooks.label: Equip Spells with payoff
hooks.why: Drastea equips Equip Spells from the Deck, Diactorus searches one when destroyed, and every Equip Card gets attached to the Xyz boss as material or destroyed as a cost, so Equip Spells that do something when destroyed or from the GY never go to waste.

profile.plan: Trap-monster Zombies that Summon themselves, Fusion Summon Zombies, and use Eldlich the Golden Lord as the payoff, banishing Golden Land traps from the GY to keep setting more.

hooks.label: Zombie support
hooks.why: Every Golden Land monster is a Zombie, and Seven Cities of the Golden Land Fusion Summons using only Zombie monsters, so generic Zombie support covers the whole deck.

hooks.label: Rewards being Tributed
hooks.why: Golden Land Forever! Tributes a Zombie monster as a cost and Fallen Angel can be Summoned by Tributing a LIGHT Zombie, so outside Zombies with effects when Tributed get triggered for free.

hooks.label: Zombie Fusion helpers
hooks.why: Seven Cities of the Golden Land Fusion Summons using Zombies from the hand or field, so outside cards that Fusion Summon with Zombie materials or substitute for them extend the deck's boss plays.

profile.plan: LIGHT Fairies that lean on the Field Spell The Sanctuary in the Sky, banishing their own Fairies from the GY as costs and rewarding a Life Point lead over the opponent.

hooks.label: LIGHT Fairy support
hooks.why: Every Agent and Hyperion is a LIGHT Fairy and Moon's Link Summon demands Fairy material, so generic LIGHT Fairy support works across the whole deck.

hooks.label: Wants to be banished from the GY
hooks.why: Master Hyperion, Jupiter and Pluto all banish monsters from your Graveyard as costs, so outside monsters with an effect when banished get it for free.

hooks.label: Life Point lead payoffs
hooks.why: Saturn burns for the LP difference and Mars gains ATK while your Life Points are higher than your opponent's, so outside cards built on having more Life Points stack with them.

hooks.label: Field Spell enablers
hooks.why: Earth, Uranus, Hyperion, Saturn, Mars and Jupiter all need The Sanctuary in the Sky on the field or in the GY, so outside cards that put a Field Spell there are activators.

hooks.label: Wants to be sent from the Deck
hooks.why: Uranus sends an Agent monster from the Deck to the GY as a cost for its Level change, so outside monsters with an effect when sent there trigger for free.

profile.plan: A pack of FIRE Dinosaurs that win battles on purpose: nearly every Jurrac pays off when it destroys a monster by battle or is destroyed itself, and the deck happily kills its own Dinosaurs and banishes its GY to fuel Synchro plays.

hooks.label: Destroys your own Dinosaurs
hooks.why: Jurrac Volcano and Jurrac Stego destroy a Dinosaur you control as the cost of their effects, so outside cards that blow up your own Dinosaurs are extra activators for them.

hooks.label: Dinosaurs that want to be destroyed
hooks.why: The deck destroys its own Dinosaurs with Volcano and Stego and loses them in battle constantly, so outside Dinosaurs with effects when destroyed get triggered for free.

hooks.label: Dinosaurs that want to be Tributed
hooks.why: Jurrac Aeolo and Jurrac Tyrannus Tribute Dinosaurs as costs, so outside Dinosaurs with an effect when Tributed get it for free.

hooks.label: Banishes your GY Dinosaurs
hooks.why: Titano, Astero and Volcano all banish Dinosaur monsters from your GY as costs, so the deck piles up GY Dinosaurs that outside cards like Double Evolution Pill can spend.

hooks.label: Dinosaur support
hooks.why: Every Jurrac monster and all their Synchro bosses are Dinosaur-Type, so generic Dinosaur search, revive and boost cards work on the whole deck.

profile.plan: Pendulum Psychics that destroy their own face-up cards to Set Metalfoes Spells/Traps and then Fusion Summon using Pendulum Monsters from the hand, field and face-up Extra Deck.

hooks.label: Destroys your own cards
hooks.why: Every Metalfoes Pendulum Scale effect and Vanisher's Summon condition destroy face-up cards you control as the cost or trigger, so outside cards that destroy your own cards set the whole engine off.

hooks.label: Wants to be destroyed
hooks.why: The deck destroys its own face-up cards every turn, so outside cards that gain an effect when they are destroyed by a card effect get it for free.

hooks.label: Pendulum support
hooks.why: Electrumite searches and recycles Pendulum Monsters and draws when Pendulum Zone cards leave the field, so any outside card built around Pendulum Monsters or Scales slots straight in.

hooks.label: Psychic support
hooks.why: Every Metalfoes monster, including the Fusions and Links, is a Psychic, so generic Psychic support works on the whole deck.

hooks.label: Normal Monster support
hooks.why: The Main Deck Metalfoes are Normal Monsters and Alkahest requires a Normal Monster as Fusion Material, so cards that search, protect or revive Normal Monsters fit.

hooks.label: Fusion Summon payoffs
hooks.why: Metalfoes Combination triggers whenever any Fusion Monster is Fusion Summoned and Orichalc and Mithrilium reward Fusion Summoning, so outside cards that Fusion Summon add value each time.

profile.plan: Level 8 monsters that Special Summon themselves from the GY once you control King's Sarcophagus, and pay you back whenever the opponent's card effects make your cards leave the field.

hooks.label: Searches Continuous Spells
hooks.why: All four Horus monsters only revive from the GY while you control King's Sarcophagus, a Continuous Spell, so outside cards that fetch or place Continuous Spells keep the engine on.

hooks.label: Mills Level 8 monsters
hooks.why: Imsety, Hapi, Duamutef and Qebehsenuef Special Summon themselves from the GY, so getting them there is the setup step; any outside card that mills your own Level 8 monsters is free deployment.

hooks.label: Wants to be sent to the GY
hooks.why: Imsety sends 2 cards from the hand to the GY as a cost and Horus the Black Flame Deity sends a card from the hand or field, so outside monsters that trigger when sent to the GY get their effect for free.

hooks.label: Level 8 monsters
hooks.why: Every Horus monster is Level 8, so outside Level 8 monsters fuel Duamutef's draw-for-different-names payoff and fit any Level 8 support the deck runs.

profile.plan: WATER Flip monsters that hide face-down, bounce the opponent's cards away, and Synchro Summon using Penguins that flip themselves back up.

hooks.label: WATER Synchro monsters
hooks.why: First Penguin searches WATER monsters for them and locks the turn into WATER Extra Deck Summons, and Penguin Squire is a Tuner that can only make WATER Synchros.

hooks.label: WATER Flip monsters
hooks.why: Penguin Brave flips a face-down Defense Position WATER monster face-up as a Quick Effect, so any outside WATER Flip monster gets its FLIP effect on demand.

hooks.label: Flips your face-down monsters
hooks.why: The deck fills the field with face-down Defense Position Penguins (Penguin Brave, Penguin Ninja), so outside cards that flip your own face-down monsters face-up trigger their effects and Puny Penguin's sent-to-GY payoff.

hooks.label: Sets monsters
hooks.why: Penguin Squire Special Summons itself from hand whenever a monster is Set on your field, so outside cards that Set monsters are free extenders.

hooks.label: Aqua WATER support
hooks.why: Nearly every Penguin is an Aqua WATER monster, and the deck's Synchro and flip payoffs all specify WATER.

hooks.label: Damages yourself
hooks.why: Guard Penguin Special Summons itself from hand and heals you whenever you take effect damage, turning self-damage costs into a free body.

profile.plan: A burn-and-battle deck that sends its own Cubic monsters to the GY to Summon bigger ones, stacks ATK, places Cubic Counters to lock the opponent down, and Fusion Summons its Dark Cubic Lords.

hooks.label: Fiend support
hooks.why: The deck's core bosses Vijam, Crimson Nova and Crimson Nova Trinity are all DARK Fiends, so generic Fiend searchers, revives and boosts work on them.

hooks.label: Triggers on effect damage you take
hooks.why: Crimson Nova burns you for 3000 every End Phase and Crimson Nova Trinity reflects effect damage you take, so outside cards with an effect when you take effect damage fire for free every turn.

hooks.label: Grants extra attacks
hooks.why: Dark Garnex, Blade Garoodia, Buster Gundil and both Dark Cubic Lords all trigger off destroying monsters by battle and several can attack again, so outside cards that grant additional attacks multiply the triggers.

hooks.label: Wants to be discarded
hooks.why: Cubic Bodhi and Pritima discard any card from your hand as a cost, so outside cards with an effect when a card effect discards them get it for free.

hooks.label: Fusion Summons with hand and field
hooks.why: Pritima, Alditia and Cubic Bodhi all Fusion Summon using monsters from your hand or field, so outside cards that Fusion Summon the same way can bring out the Cubic Fusion bosses or pair with them.

profile.plan: Sticky WATER Aqua slimes that spawn Tokens and turn Traps into giant Level 10 wall-monsters, ready to be Tributed away for something bigger.

hooks.label: Tribute Summon support
hooks.why: Metal Reflect Slime and Egyptian God Slime become easy Level 10 bodies on the field, so outside cards that Tribute monsters or reward Tribute Summoning convert them into big bosses.

hooks.label: Aqua WATER support
hooks.why: Every Slime monster and Trap-monster is an Aqua WATER monster, so generic support for that Type or Attribute hits the whole deck.

hooks.label: Token support
hooks.why: Jam Breeding Machine floods the field with Slime Tokens each Standby Phase, so outside cards that care about Tokens or Tribute them as material get free fuel.

hooks.label: Rank 10 Xyz support
hooks.why: Metal Reflect Slime and Egyptian God Slime are both Level 10, so outside cards that use the highest-Level monsters as Xyz material give the deck real Extra Deck bosses.

hooks.label: Battle damage redirectors
hooks.why: Magical Reflect Slime's Gemini effect and Revival Jam's self-revival want the opponent's attacks funneled into battles, so cards that force attacks or redirect battle damage finish the plan.

profile.plan: Summons Queen's, King's and Jack's Knight through Normal Summons and deck effects, then cashes them in for Level 10 jokers or the Arcana Knight Joker Fusion.

hooks.label: LIGHT Warrior support
hooks.why: Every monster in the deck, including Arcana Knight Joker, is a LIGHT Warrior, and Joker's Knight and Joker's Straight can recover any LIGHT Warrior from the GY.

hooks.label: Grants extra Normal Summons
hooks.why: King's Knight only Summons Jack's Knight when Normal Summoned while Queen's Knight is up, and Joker's Straight and Thunderspeed Summon both chain an extra Normal Summon after resolving, so more Normal Summons means more triggers.

hooks.label: Normal Monster support
hooks.why: Queen's Knight and Jack's Knight are Normal Monsters, so cards that search, protect or revive Normal Monsters work on half the deck.

hooks.label: Level 10 Tribute bosses
hooks.why: Thunderspeed Summon Normal Summons any Level 10 monster and searches Level 10 non-DARK ? ATK monsters like Arcana Triumph Joker, so other big Level 10 monsters fit the same slot.

hooks.label: Wants to be discarded
hooks.why: Joker's Straight and Arcana Triumph Joker's destruction effect both discard a card as a cost, so outside cards with an effect when discarded get it for free.

profile.plan: EARTH Fairy millers that send the top five cards of both Decks to the GY, trigger off each other falling into the GY, and use Exchange of the Spirit to turn graveyards into win conditions.

hooks.label: Mills your opponent's Deck
hooks.why: Kelbek and Agido Special Summon themselves when a card is sent from the hand or Deck to the opponent's GY, so outside cards that mill the opponent are activators.

hooks.label: Mills your own Deck
hooks.why: Kelbek, Agido and Blast Held all have effects when they are sent from the hand or Deck to your GY, so outside millers that hit your own Deck set them off.

hooks.label: Wants to be milled
hooks.why: The deck's engine mills ten or more cards at a time, so outside monsters with an effect when they are sent from the hand or Deck to the GY get it for free.

hooks.label: EARTH Fairy support
hooks.why: Every monster in the deck is an EARTH Fairy, and Agido and Blast Held specifically revive or retrieve Level 4 EARTH Fairies.

hooks.label: Fills the GY for Exchange
hooks.why: Mudora and Keldo banish themselves from the GY and get stronger shuffles while Exchange of the Spirit is in the GY, so cards that put Spell/Trap cards or many cards into your own GY fuel the payoff.

profile.plan: Summons the Aesir gods by Synchro Summoning them with Nordic Tuners and non-Tuners, recycling Nordic monsters from the hand, Deck and GY as material.

hooks.label: Wants to be banished
hooks.why: Gullveig banishes up to 3 cards from your hand and field as its Link Summon cost, so outside cards with an effect when they are banished get triggered for free.

hooks.label: Wants to be sent to the GY
hooks.why: Vanadis sends a Nordic monster from the Deck to the GY to change Level and Mimir sends Spells from the hand to the GY as a cost, so outside cards with an effect when sent to the GY get used for free.

hooks.label: Wants to be Tributed
hooks.why: Nordic Relic Svalinn Tributes a Nordic monster as a cost to revive an Aesir, so outside monsters with an effect when Tributed turn that cost into advantage.

hooks.label: Synchro Monster support
hooks.why: The deck's whole payoff is Aesir Synchro Monsters, and Gullveig and Svalinn protect and revive them, so outside cards that support Synchro Monsters work on every boss.

hooks.label: Battle destruction triggers
hooks.why: Tanngrisnir summons Tokens when destroyed by battle and Tanngnjostr Summons itself from hand when any of your monsters dies by battle, so outside cards that force or enable battles with your monsters set those off.

profile.plan: Fiends that Special Summon themselves by banishing their kin from the hand and GY, keep their own Levels low, and pay for negates and GY banishment by Tributing whatever is on the field.

hooks.label: Mills your own Deck
hooks.why: Decatron, Void Launch and Infernoid Evil all send Infernoid monsters from the Deck to the GY, which is exactly where their Summoning costs want them.

hooks.label: Banishes from your own GY
hooks.why: Every big Infernoid Summons itself by banishing Infernoid monsters from the hand or GY, so outside cards that banish your GY as a cost feed that pool and trigger Infernoid Flood's removal.

hooks.label: Wants to be banished
hooks.why: Infernoids banish their own monsters from the hand and GY as a Summoning cost, so outside monsters with an effect when banished get it for free.

hooks.label: Wants to be Tributed
hooks.why: Nearly every Infernoid pays for its negate or GY-banish Quick Effect by Tributing a monster, so outside monsters with an effect when Tributed turn that cost into value.

hooks.label: Token and Tribute fodder
hooks.why: The deck constantly Tributes monsters for Quick Effects and banishes its own GY, so cards that make Tokens or freely summon bodies keep the costs flowing.

hooks.label: Fiend support
hooks.why: Every Infernoid monster is a FIRE Fiend, so generic Fiend support works across the whole deck.

profile.plan: ATK 0 fighters that hand all their battle damage to the opponent when equipped, swapping Equip Spells between monsters to redirect and multiply attacks.

hooks.label: Equip Spells
hooks.why: Every monster's protection and damage reflection turns on being equipped, and Ha-Re and Hu-Li search when an Equip Card is equipped to them, so any outside Equip Spell is live.

hooks.label: Recovers Equip Spells from the GY
hooks.why: Ohime equips an Equip Spell from the GY and Mikanko Rivalry adds one back to the hand, so outside cards that recycle Equip Spells keep the loop going.

hooks.label: Piercing and battle damage boosts
hooks.why: Mikanko monsters have 0 ATK but reflect all battle damage you would take onto the opponent, so anything that increases battle damage or adds piercing turns their attacks into lethal burn.

hooks.label: Forces your opponent to attack
hooks.why: Heavenly Gate of the Mikanko locks every opposing attacker onto your equipped monsters, which only matters if the opponent actually attacks, so cards that force attacks close the trap.

hooks.label: Level 3 monsters
hooks.why: Uzuhime needs 2 Level 3 Mikanko monsters as Xyz material and the Level 3 main deck monsters want more bodies at that Level, so outside Level 3s that Summon themselves fit.

hooks.label: Reacts to being Tributed
hooks.why: Mikanko Kagura Tributes monsters from your hand or field as Ritual material, so outside monsters with an effect when Tributed get it for free.

profile.plan: A Zombie Ritual deck that Tribute Summons DARK Zombie Ritual Monsters using its small monsters, which then gain extra effects, while fueling costs by banishing Zombie monsters from the GY.

hooks.label: Sends Zombie monsters to GY
hooks.why: Slayer, Battlelord, Houndhorde and Striges all trigger when Vendread monsters are sent to the GY, so outside cards that mill Zombie monsters from the Deck start those effects for free.

hooks.label: Wants to be banished from GY
hooks.why: Slayer's attack boost, Origin's protection, Nights' extra attack and Core's revival all banish Zombie monsters from your GY as a cost, so outside cards with effects that trigger when banished get value for free.

hooks.label: Tributes monsters
hooks.why: Scar of the Vendread Special Summons itself from the GY whenever a monster on the field is Tributed, so any outside card that Tributes a monster is another revival trigger.

hooks.label: Ritual support
hooks.why: The whole deck is built around Ritual Summoning DARK Zombie Ritual Monsters from hand or GY, so generic Ritual enablers fit every part of it.

hooks.label: Zombie support
hooks.why: Every monster in the archetype is a Zombie, from Avendread Savior's Link materials to Origin's banish fuel, so generic Zombie support works on the entire deck.

profile.plan: Continuous Fire Formation Spells and Traps that power up and support Beast-Warrior (Fire Fist) monsters, searching them, granting extra Summons and Fusion/Ritual access.

hooks.label: Beast-Warrior support
hooks.why: Every Fire Formation boosts or protects Beast-Warrior monsters, and Tenki and Liang Peak search or Summon them, so any Beast-Warrior support card slots straight in.

hooks.label: Level 4 or lower Beast-Warriors
hooks.why: Tenki adds any Level 4 or lower Beast-Warrior from the Deck, so outside monsters of that profile are direct search targets.

hooks.label: Normal Summon triggers
hooks.why: Tensu grants an extra Normal Summon of a Beast-Warrior each turn, so monsters with powerful 'when Normal Summoned' effects get an extra activation.

hooks.label: Rewards when discarded
hooks.why: Fire Formation - Yoko discards a Beast-Warrior as a cost, so outside Beast-Warriors with effects when they are discarded get used for free.

hooks.label: Continuous Spell payoffs
hooks.why: The whole deck stacks Continuous Spells and Traps, so outside cards that reward you for controlling Continuous Spells get better as it plays out.

hooks.label: Piercing damage
hooks.why: Fire Formation - Kaiyo gives your Beast-Warriors piercing against Defense Position monsters, so cards that push attacks or add more piercing stack the damage.

profile.plan: A scattered anti-magic suite of Traps that shut down, negate or punish Spell Cards, plus a couple of monsters that piggyback on the Spell-hate game plan.

hooks.label: Spell Counter makers
hooks.why: Anti-Spell negates a Spell by removing 2 Spell Counters, so any outside card that generates Spell Counters fuels it.

hooks.label: Negates opponent's Spells
hooks.why: The whole archetype is built around stopping Spell activations (Anti-Spell, Anti Raigeki, Anti-Spell Fragrance), so outside cards that negate or punish a Spell activation pile on the same plan.

hooks.label: Punishes Set backrow
hooks.why: Anti-Spell Fragrance forces both players to Set Spells before activating them, so outside cards that destroy or punish face-down Set cards get guaranteed targets.

hooks.label: Cyberse support
hooks.why: Antialian Normal Summons a Cyberse monster after battle, so Cyberse monsters worth Summoning, and cards that support them, fit its effect.

hooks.label: Insects worth Tributing
hooks.why: Anti-Aircraft Flower inflicts 800 damage by Tributing an Insect, so Insect monsters that trigger when Tributed pay for themselves.

profile.plan: A FIRE Dragon battle deck that Synchro Summons Dragions, forces and rewards multiple attacks in one turn, and digs out Level 4 or lower FIRE Dragons to keep the Battle Phase going.

hooks.label: FIRE Dragon monsters
hooks.why: Sangen Kaimen searches and Special Summons FIRE Dragons from the hand, Sangen Summoning protects them and Sangen Kaiho demands your whole board be FIRE Dragons, so any outside FIRE Dragon Main Deck monster slots straight in.

hooks.label: Extra attacks each turn
hooks.why: Bident Dragion, Transcendent Dragion and Sangen Kaiho all have bonuses that need 3 or more attacks declared in a turn, so outside cards that grant additional attacks or all-attacking reach that number fast.

hooks.label: Triggers on attack declarations
hooks.why: The deck's payoff effects count attacks declared, so outside cards whose effects trigger when a monster declares an attack fire repeatedly in the same Battle Phase.

hooks.label: Dragon Synchro support
hooks.why: Both Sangenpai Synchro bosses require a Dragon Tuner plus Dragon non-Tuners, and Sangen Summoning doubles a Dragon Synchro's ATK, so generic Dragon Synchro tools and other Dragon Synchro monsters fit naturally.

hooks.label: Destroyed by battle rewards
hooks.why: Sangen Furo Special Summons monsters destroyed by battle involving your FIRE Dragon back to your field, so outside cards with effects when they are destroyed by battle get a free revival plus their own trigger.

profile.plan: A slow burn alternate-win deck that assembles Destiny Board plus the four Spirit Message cards in order, stalling behind Fiends and coin-flip protection until 'FINAL' spells victory.

hooks.label: Level 8 Fiend bosses
hooks.why: Dark Spirit's Mastery adds any Level 8 Fiend from Deck or GY alongside Destiny Board, so any big Level 8 Fiend is this deck's real finisher.

hooks.label: Protects your backrow
hooks.why: Destiny Board and every Spirit Message card fall apart and go to the GY the moment any one of them leaves the field, so outside cards that stop your Spells/Traps being destroyed or removed keep the win condition alive.

hooks.label: Wants to be discarded
hooks.why: Dark Spirit's Mastery's search costs a discard, so outside cards with an effect when a card effect discards them turn the cost into advantage.

hooks.label: Fiend support
hooks.why: The Spirit Messages become Level 1 DARK Fiends under Dark Sanctuary and Mastery searches Fiends, so generic Fiend support pulls the whole deck together.

hooks.label: Coin toss cards
hooks.why: Dark Sanctuary's attack negate runs on a coin toss, so outside cards that replay or fix coin tosses make it reliable.

profile.plan: A LIGHT-heavy painting-themed deck that Fusion Summons on both players' turns, repeatedly bounces its own monsters back to the hand and Extra Deck, and unlocks stronger Quick Effects once it controls 3 or more different Monster Types.

hooks.label: Rewards different Monster Types
hooks.why: Graflare's Quick Effect destruction, Finmel's stat halving, Diactorus's negation and Impasto's mass bounce all switch on when you control 3 or more different Monster Types, so any outside card that puts a new Monster Type on your field raises the ceiling.

hooks.label: Spell/Trap discard fodder
hooks.why: Artmage Academic Arcane Arts Acropolis and Non-Finito both pay by discarding 1 Spell/Trap, so outside Spell/Traps with an effect in the GY get used for free as cost.

hooks.label: Wants to be bounced
hooks.why: Litera, Pact -Awakening- and Peripeteia constantly return your own monsters to the hand or Extra Deck as cost or setup, so outside monsters with an effect when they return to the hand or leave the field trigger on cue.

hooks.label: Illusion support
hooks.why: Artmage Power Patron, Nervedo the Shadebeast Power Patron and Non-Finito are all Illusion monsters, so generic Illusion support covers the deck's core engine.

hooks.label: Recovers from banishment
hooks.why: Nervedo banishes the top 3 cards of your Deck face-down and Diactorus can Special Summon a monster from banishment, so outside cards that use or return banished cards turn a cost into value.

profile.plan: FIRE Machine gunslingers that stack themselves onto Rank 4 and Rank 8 Xyz Monsters from the hand, field and GY, spend those materials for removal and searches, and dodge with banish-until-End-Phase effects while setting up Fallen of Albaz Fusions.

hooks.label: Detached material payoffs
hooks.why: Exblowrer, Sargas, Tally-ho! Springans and Springans Watch all detach materials as cost or effect, so outside cards that trigger when detached come off for free.

hooks.label: Gains effect as material
hooks.why: Sargas grants a 500 ATK boost while attached, and every Springans mains stacks cards onto their Xyz Monsters, so outside cards with effects that work while attached as Xyz Material ride along.

hooks.label: Generic Rank 4 Xyz
hooks.why: The deck swarms Level 4 Springans easily and Gung-Ho! Springans and Merrymaker take 2+ Level 4 monsters, so any Xyz Monster that lists two Level 4 materials can sit on the same board.

hooks.label: Albaz Fusion support
hooks.why: Kitt summons itself off an Albaz Fusion on field or in GY, Merrymaker and Springans Call! send Albaz Fusions to the GY and attach them as material, and Blast! upgrades with one, so anything that works with Fallen of Albaz Fusions is already half this deck's plan.

hooks.label: Branded Spells/Traps
hooks.why: Springans Kitt adds any Branded Spell or Trap from Deck, GY or banishment straight to the hand, so Branded cards are searchable by the archetype itself.

hooks.label: Big Level 8 monsters
hooks.why: Sargas and Branga are Level 8 and Springans Interluder's negate doubles as a revive for any Level 8 monster from the GY, so outside Level 8 bosses are both stackable material and a payoff target.

profile.plan: Aqua control deck that floods the field with WATER monsters, equips its own monsters to each other, and punishes anything that touches them with banishment and revival.

hooks.label: Sends WATER monsters to the GY
hooks.why: Tremora, Acti, Tinola and Ran Aegirine all send WATER monsters from the hand to the GY as cost or setup, so outside cards triggered that way come along for free.

hooks.label: Wants to be sent to the GY
hooks.why: The deck constantly sends WATER monsters from the hand to the GY, so outside monsters with an effect in the GY when sent there by a card effect get used as material.

hooks.label: Banishes your monsters from the GY
hooks.why: Aegirocassis gains 400 ATK/DEF for each banished monster while equipped, and Gymir Aegirine Special Summons itself when cards get banished, so anything that banishes your monsters feeds both.

hooks.label: WATER Tuners
hooks.why: Gymir Aegirine Synchro Summons with a WATER Tuner plus any non-Tuners, so outside WATER Tuners are extra Synchro material.

hooks.label: Aqua and WATER support
hooks.why: Every Icejade monster is a WATER Aqua and Tremora, Aegirine and Manifestation revive or summon WATER monsters generically, so Type and Attribute support covers the whole deck.

hooks.label: Field Spells
hooks.why: Kosmochlor Special Summons itself for free when any face-up card is in a Field Zone, and its lock only works while a Field Spell is up, so any outside Field Spell pays for it.

profile.plan: A Extra Deck toolbox of huge Fusion/Xyz/Synchro/Link bosses that banish cards face-down, warp between zones, and turn their own Pendulum boss into a walking mass-banish.

hooks.label: Face-down banish payoffs
hooks.why: Vidolium banishes both GYs face-down on Summon, Shade of the Final Hour banishes the opponent's Deck, hand and field face-down, and Plundered Plane weakens the opponent 100 ATK per banished card, so anything that banishes face-down stacks with the deck's strategy.

hooks.label: DARK Fairy support
hooks.why: Terminus searches any DARK Fairy from the Deck, Purification Power Patron's Quick Effect link climb just needs you to control another DARK Fairy, and Vidolium itself is one.

hooks.label: Level 10 Extra Deck monsters
