hooks.why: Helpoemer discards 1 other card as the cost of Special Summoning itself, so outside cards with an effect when discarded get triggered for free.

hooks.label: Sends your own monsters to GY
hooks.why: Makyura Sets a Sun God Spell/Trap straight from the Deck when it is sent from hand or field to the GY, and Lava Golem's alternate Summon also sends monsters to the GY as its procedure, so cards that dump your own monsters fuel both.

hooks.label: Fiend support
hooks.why: Three of the four Main Deck monsters plus the Fusion are Fiends, so generic Fiend searchers, revives and boosts cover the deck.

hooks.label: Fusion Summon enablers
hooks.why: Lava Golem is Fusion Summoned with 1 Sun God monster plus any 2 face-up monsters on the field, so generic Fusion Spells and fusion-substitute support work.

hooks.label: Battle protection payoffs
hooks.why: Viser Des Shock cannot be destroyed by battle and bounces a card when summoned, so it wins grindy battles; outside cards that lock attacks or protect further build on that.

profile.plan: Level 2 Fiends that swarm the field by discarding and reviving each other, flooding the board for Rank 2 Xyz Summons.

hooks.label: Wants to be sent to the GY
hooks.why: Fork Special Summons itself by sending any other Fiend from your hand to the Graveyard, so outside Fiends with effects that trigger when sent there get their effect for free.

hooks.label: Level 2 Fiends
hooks.why: Spoon Special Summons any Level 2 Fiend from your Graveyard whenever a Malicevorous monster is Summoned, so outside Level 2 Fiends with better effects than the archetype's own get revived for free.

hooks.label: Extra Normal Summons
hooks.why: Knife only triggers when Normal Summoned and the deck wants repeated Summons to keep setting off Spoon, so cards granting additional Normal Summons power the whole engine.

hooks.label: Rank 2 Xyz payoffs
hooks.why: The deck floods the field with multiple Level 2 Fiends at once, so Rank 2 Xyz Monsters are the natural payoff.

profile.plan: A Rank-Up-Magic Xyz deck that stacks Umbral Horror and Number monsters into layered Xyz Summons, turning every Rank-Up into a bigger Chaos Number with stolen material attached.

hooks.label: Rank-Up-Magic Spells
hooks.why: Barian Untopia triggers on Special Summoning an Xyz Monster with a Rank-Up-Magic Spell's effect and attaches an opponent's monster as punishment, so any Rank-Up-Magic is the deck's engine.

hooks.label: Attaches material to your Xyz
hooks.why: Barian's Seal and Barian's Hope both reward Xyz Monsters carrying extra material, and attaching more monsters keeps their big Numbers loaded.

hooks.label: Number Xyz monsters
hooks.why: Barian's Seventh Untopia only allows more than 2 Extra Deck Summons per turn if they are Number monsters, and Untopia's protection covers the 101-107 Numbers, so outside Number Xyz bosses fit freely.

hooks.label: Level-matching extenders
hooks.why: Barian's Chaos Draw and Barian's Hope Xyz Summon using your own monsters, and Hope needs all your Umbral Horrors sharing a Level, so cards that make Levels match turn any board into overlay material.

profile.plan: A trio of Spells that summon and buff a generic low-stat monster, granting it any Level or Tuner status on demand to improvise Synchro, Xyz and Fusion plays, with a GY effect that revives Extra Deck monsters through Link arrows.

hooks.label: Link Monsters with arrows
hooks.why: Past Lull's GY effect can only revive a Fusion, Synchro or Xyz Monster to a zone a Link Monster points to, so the deck needs Link Monsters of its own to point there.

hooks.label: Makes a monster a Tuner
hooks.why: Liberation already treats a monster you control as a Tuner for a turn, so more outside cards that hand out Tuner status let the deck Synchro Summon with any of its monsters.

hooks.label: Changes a monster's Level
hooks.why: Overdrive declares any Level from 1 to 10 for a monster you control, so the deck can reach any Synchro or Xyz monster if outside cards also change Levels.

profile.plan: A luck-based gambler deck that rolls dice and tosses coins to summon its monsters, makes Sheep Tokens, revives from both Graveyards, and slips in a Jinzo and a Legendary Fisherman along the way.

hooks.label: Six-sided die cards
hooks.why: Graceful & Skull Dice and Reversal Box are built around rolling a six-sided die, so any outside card that also rolls one stacks with the deck's rolls and luck-manipulation.

hooks.label: Coin toss cards
hooks.why: Reversal Box's negation and summon hinge on calling a coin toss right, so outside cards that toss coins and manipulate tosses pair with it.

hooks.label: Jinzo support
hooks.why: Jinzo - Energy Shocker becomes "Jinzo" on the field and in the GY, so every piece of Jinzo support revives it, equips to it or searches it.

hooks.label: Umi and WATER sea support
hooks.why: Fisherman of Legend triggers itself when "Umi" is on the field, so Umi and cards that mention or place Umi switch it on for free.

hooks.label: Fusion Summons with your monsters
hooks.why: Sleepy Scapegoats floods the field with Sheep Tokens and locks you into Fusion Monsters only, so outside cards that Fusion Summon using monsters you control convert those Tokens and boards into real bosses.

profile.plan: Summons a board of 0 ATK Rock 'treasures' that search the deck when Summoned and pay Life Points when destroyed, then wins with Triangle O which wipes the field and reflects all that effect damage onto the opponent.

hooks.label: Equip Spell searchers
hooks.why: Ashoka Pillar adds any Equip Spell from the Deck when Summoned, so any strong outside Equip Spell becomes a free search.

hooks.label: Self-burn payoffs
hooks.why: Crystal Skull only recovers a 0 ATK Rock if you took effect damage that turn, and Triangle O redirects all effect damage you would take to the opponent, so cards that burn you turn into both fuel and damage.

hooks.label: Triggers on effect damage
hooks.why: The deck takes effect damage constantly from its own cards (1000-2000 a pop), so outside cards that react to you taking damage fire for free every turn.

hooks.label: Rock support
hooks.why: Every Ancient Treasure monster is a Rock, so generic Rock searchers, revivals and boosters work on the whole deck.

hooks.label: 0 ATK monsters
hooks.why: Crystal Skull searches or Special Summons any 0 ATK Rock from the Deck, so outside 0 ATK Rocks are directly fetchable, and Triangle O shuffles three of them back to draw 3.

profile.plan: WATER Sea Serpents that treat themselves as the Field Spell "Umi" and feed on Atlantis, wiping the board or the opponent's hand by sending their face-up "Umi" to the GY.

hooks.label: Umi synergy cards
hooks.why: All the Daedalus monsters' names become "Umi" while on the field, so any outside card that cares about a "Umi" being on the field is live the moment one is Summoned.

hooks.label: Finds Field Spells
hooks.why: Levia-Dragon's hand-Summon and Daedalus Maelstrom's negate both require controlling "Atlantis, City of the Sea Dragon", so outside cards that search or place Field Spells get it out reliably.

hooks.label: WATER Link Monsters
hooks.why: Daedalus Maelstrom destroys every non-WATER monster only if you control a WATER Link Monster, and Neo-Daedalus needs 4 monsters as Link material, so other WATER Link Monsters double as material and payoff.

hooks.label: WATER monster support
hooks.why: Every Daedalus monster is a WATER Sea Serpent and Levia-Dragoon requires 3 WATER monsters as Link material, so cards that swarm or support WATER monsters keep the engine going.

profile.plan: Cyberse bunnies that summon cheap Normal Monsters and keep swarming them, then reward you for Special Summoning or attacking with big Level 5+ vanillas.

hooks.label: Big cheap vanillas
hooks.why: Bunnillin Soft and Extract pay off when a Level 5+ Normal Monster with 2000 or less ATK is Special Summoned or attacks, so any outside vanilla of that shape is a win condition.

hooks.label: Wants to be milled
hooks.why: Mocha MOD sends a Normal Monster with 2000 or less ATK from the Deck to the GY as its Summoning cost, so outside monsters that do something when sent from the Deck to the GY get it for free.

hooks.label: Mills the opponent's Deck
hooks.why: Bunnillin Extract Special Summons a Normal Monster from hand or Deck whenever a card is sent from the opponent's Deck to the GY, so any outside milling effect is an extender.

hooks.label: Normal Monster support
hooks.why: The whole deck is built around controlling multiple non-Token Normal Monsters, so outside cards that search, revive or power up Normal Monsters strengthen everything it does.

profile.plan: Insect Ritual monsters that pay for their Ritual Summons by shuffling Insect and Dragon monsters from the GY back into the Deck, then refill the GY by sending their own cards there.

hooks.label: Mills Insect monsters
hooks.why: Reindsurm Conquest and Amurusa fuel Ritual Summons with Insect/Dragon monsters in the GY, and Butterfly mills Insects directly, so any outside card that sends Insect monsters from the Deck to the GY is more ammo.

hooks.label: Wants to be sent to the GY
hooks.why: The deck constantly sends its own cards to the GY as costs and effects (Butterfly, Carnation, Conquest, Gigalovendra), so outside monsters with an effect when sent to the GY trigger for free.

hooks.label: Outside Insect Rituals
hooks.why: Conquest can Ritual Summon any number of Insect Ritual Monsters and Amurusa, Carcasas and Luvian summon an Insect Ritual Monster straight from the hand, so any non-Reindsurm Insect Ritual monster is a usable boss.

hooks.label: Dragon GY fodder
hooks.why: Conquest, Amurusa, Carcasas and Luvian all accept Dragon monsters from the GY as Ritual material, and Giriakarma doubles its ATK against Dragons, so Dragon monsters that send themselves to the GY are premium fuel.

hooks.label: Insect support
hooks.why: Reindsurm Butterfly locks you into Special Summoning Insect monsters only, so generic Insect searchers, revival and boosters keep working under the lock.

hooks.label: Ritual deck support
hooks.why: The whole engine is built on Ritual Summoning Insects with material from the hand, field and GY, so generic Ritual support that searches Ritual Monsters or Spells fits the plan directly.

profile.plan: Illusion monsters that hide face-up in the Spell & Trap Zone as Continuous Spells, then leap back out as monsters; the Synchro knights reward being sent to the GY and the Witch traps Fusion Summon Illusion and Diabell bosses from the Extra Deck.

hooks.label: Wants to be sent to the GY
hooks.why: Mart's first effect sends 1 other card from your hand or field to the GY as a cost, so outside monsters with an effect when they are sent there get it for free.

hooks.label: Monsters that live in the Spell & Trap Zone
hooks.why: The deck parks its monsters face-up in the Spell & Trap Zone, and Purifire can Special Summon any Level 7 or 8 Monster Card sitting there, so outside monsters that place themselves there as Continuous Spells fit perfectly.

hooks.label: Illusion support
hooks.why: Every Winter Raven monster is an Illusion, the Synchro knights require an Illusion Tuner, and Illusion of the Winter Raven Witch only Fusion Summons Illusion Fusions, so generic Illusion support covers the whole deck.

hooks.label: Illusion Fusion Monsters
hooks.why: Illusion of the Winter Raven Witch Fusion Summons an Illusion Fusion Monster using Extra Deck and field monsters, so outside Illusion Fusions are its targets.

hooks.label: Sinful Spoils cards
hooks.why: Purifire of the Winter Raven's Forest searches any Sinful Spoils card, and Splendor of the Winter Raven Witch Fusion Summons Diabell monsters, so the Sinful Spoils engine slots straight in.

profile.plan: A DIVINE Divine-Beast build that dumps The Winged Dragon of Ra into the GY, revives or fuses it into a boss that pays your Life Points for massive ATK and clears the field.

hooks.label: Wants to be Tributed
hooks.why: Dangers of the Divine Tributes a monster as a cost to Summon Ra, so outside cards with an effect when they are Tributed get used for free.

hooks.label: Wants to be sent to the GY
hooks.why: The Sun God Leading Down into Darkness and The Immortal Sun God send your own monsters to the GY by card effect, so outside cards that trigger there get used for free.

hooks.label: Divine-Beast support
hooks.why: All of the deck's monsters are DIVINE Divine-Beasts, so generic Divine-Beast support works on the whole deck.

hooks.label: Pays Life Points for power
hooks.why: Sun God of Darkness pays LP so you only have 1 left to gain massive ATK, so outside cards whose costs or payoffs involve heavy LP payment fit the deck's plan.

archetype: Atlantis, City of the Sea Dragon

profile.plan: A Umi-based WATER Sea Serpent deck whose monsters become "Umi" themselves, drop every monster's Level by 1, and turn each other's sends and Summons into more WATER monsters on the field.

hooks.label: Umi support
hooks.why: Every monster in the deck is treated as "Umi" and Advent of Atlantis places "Umi" from the Deck, so any classic Umi support card is live from turn one.

hooks.label: Sea Serpent support
hooks.why: All the archetype's monsters are Sea Serpents and Advent of Atlantis searches any Level 7 Sea Serpent, so generic Sea Serpent support covers the whole deck and extends its bosses.

hooks.label: WATER monster support
hooks.why: Siren Vortex Special Summons WATER monsters from the hand and Call of Atlantis boosts WATER monsters you control, so outside WATER monsters and WATER-specific support slot straight in.

hooks.label: Wants to be sent to the GY
hooks.why: The deck sends its own cards from the Deck and field to the GY (Siren Vortex, Monster Arms' cost), so outside cards with effects when they are sent to the GY get triggered for free.

hooks.label: Level 7 WATER boss monsters
hooks.why: Advent of Atlantis searches any Level 7 Sea Serpent when sent to the GY, so big outside Level 7 Sea Serpents are direct extra bosses for the deck.

hooks.label: Links using WATER monsters
hooks.why: Atlantis reduces the material count when you Link Summon a "Daedalus" Link Monster, so outside Link Monsters that list monster materials and WATER-based Link engines pair with it.

profile.plan: Psychic monsters that fuel everything by banishing the top of their own Deck face-down, then cycling those banished cards back for Summons, searches and locks that scale with how many cards are banished face-down.

hooks.label: Banishes your own Deck face-down
hooks.why: Every Trirealm Rift monster banishes the top cards of your Deck face-down when Summoned, and Territory and Gospel banish 5 face-down to activate, so any outside card that banishes cards from your own Deck face-down feeds Darkness's banish count and Valvols's empty-Deck lock.

hooks.label: Triggers when banished
hooks.why: The deck banishes handfuls of its own cards face-down at once, so outside monsters with an effect when they are banished get it for free even face-down in the stack.

hooks.label: Recovers your banished cards
hooks.why: Darkness at 30+ and the monsters repeatedly pull face-down banished cards back, so outside cards that add or Special Summon your banished cards keep the engine looping and refill the hand after Ploutonion and Yomi shuffle things back.

hooks.label: Psychic support
hooks.why: Every Trirealm Rift monster is a Psychic, so generic Psychic searchers, revival and boosters work across the whole deck.

profile.plan: Equips small Dragon Tuners to Buster Blader monsters for layered locks, then makes the opponent's whole board Dragon-Type so Buster Blader and Karma of the Destruction Swordsman can slaughter it.

hooks.label: Dragon support
hooks.why: Dragon Buster, both Whelps and Buster Dragon are all Dragon-Type, so generic Dragon searchers, revives and boosts work across the deck.

hooks.label: Dragon Tuners
hooks.why: Buster Dragon is a Level 8 Synchro and the deck's own Tuners are Level 1 Dragons, so more Dragon Tuners keep the Synchro engine running.

hooks.label: Turns their monsters Dragon
hooks.why: Buster Dragon makes every opposing monster Dragon-Type, so outside cards that also change the opponent's monsters to Dragons stack the payoff for Buster Blader and Karma.

hooks.label: Rewards being Tributed
hooks.why: Buster Whelp Tributes itself to Special Summon a Buster Blader, so outside monsters with an effect when they are Tributed get it for free.

hooks.label: Banishes their Graveyard
hooks.why: Karma of the Destruction Swordsman banishes same-Type monsters in the opponent's GY for a big ATK swing, and Dragon Buster's lock means the opponent is left dumping Dragons, so more GY banishment compounds it.
